a: Hoil verauy lehakkisho al gabbe cheres.
Ittemar name, amar rabbi yose berabbi chanina: hoil verauy lehakkisho al gabbe cheres. rabbi yochanan amar: hoil verauy legammea bo mayim letinok.

Verabbi yochanan la bae meen melacha rishona? vehatanya: "vechol keli asher yeshev alav vegomer" — yachol kafa sea veyashav aleha, kafa tarkav veyashav aleha yehe tame, talmud lomar: "asher yeshev alav hazzav" — mi shemyuchad lishiva, yatza ze sheomrim lo: amod venaase melachtenu.
Rabbi elazar omer: bemidrasot omrim "amod venaase melachtenu", veen omrim bitme met "amod venaase melachtenu". verabbi yochanan amar: af omer bitme met "amod venaase melachtenu".
Efoch kammayyta. umay chazet deafchat kammayyta? efoch batrayyta!

Ha shaminan leh lerabbi yochanan devae meen melacha rishona. detanya: sandal shel behema shel mattechet tame. lemay chaze? amar rav: rauy lishtot bo mayim bammilchama. verabbi chanina amar: rauy lasuch bo shemen bammilchama. verabbi yochanan amar: beshaa shebboreach min hakkerav mannicho beraglav veratz al kotzin veal habbarkanim.
May ben rav lerabbi chanina? ikka benayyhu dimis.
Ben rabbi yochanan lerabbi chanina? ikka benayyhu deyakkir.
Velo beir shel zahav. may "beir shel zahav"? rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan: yerushalayim dedahava,
b: Kedaavad leh rabbi akiva lidvethu.

Tanu rabbanan: lo tetze ishsha beir shel zahav, veim yatzta chayyevet chattat, divre rabbi meir. vachachamim omrim: lo tetze, veim yatzta — petura. rabbi eliezer omer: yotza ishsha beir shel zahav lechattechilla.

Bemay kamippalgi? rabbi meir savar massoy hu. verabbanan savri tachshit hu — dilma shalfa umachveya leh veatya leetoye. verabbi eliezer savar: man dirke lemippak beir shel zahav — ishsha chashuva, veishsha chashuva la shalfa umachveya.
Kelila, rav asar ushemuel share.
Daaniska, kulle alma la peligi daasir. ki peligi daaruketa: mar savar aniska ikkar, umar savar aruketa ikkar.

Rav ashe matne lekulla: daaruketa dechulle alma la peligi dishre. ki peligi daaniska: mar savar dilma shalfa umachveya veate leetuye, umar savar man dirke lemippak bichlila — ishsha chashuva, veishsha chashuva la shalfa umachveya.
Amar leh rav shemuel bar bar chana lerav yosef: beferush amart lan mishshemeh derav — "kelila shere".

Amaru leh lerav: ata gavra rabba aricha linhardea umittela, vedaresh "kelila shere". amar: man gavra rabba aricha [deittela] — levi, shema minna nach nafsheh derabbi appas vitiv rabbi chanina beresha, vela hava leh inish lelevi lemetav gabbeh, vekaate lehacha.

Vedilma nach nafsheh derabbi chanina, verabbi appas kidkae kae, vela hava leh inish lelevi lemetav gabbeh, vekaate lehacha? im ita derabbi chanina shechev — levi lerabbi appas mikkaf hava keyif leh. vetu, derabbi chanina la saggi dela malech, dechi hava ka nicha nafsheh derabbi amar: chanina berabbi chama yeshev barosh. uchetiv behu betzaddikim: "vetigzar omer veyakom lach vegomer".
Derash levi binhardea "kelila shere". nefuk esrin vearba kelile mikkulla nehardea. derash rabba bar avu bemachoza "kelila shere", unefaku tamne sere kelile mechada mevoa.
Amar rav yehuda amar rav shemuel: kamra shere. ikka deamri daaruketa, veamar rav safra: midde dehave attallit muzehevet.
Veikka deamri daaniska, veamar rav safra: midde dehave aavnet shel melachim.
Amar leh ravina lerav ashe: kamra illave hemyayna may? amar leh tere hemyayne kaamrat.
Amar rav ashe: hay resoka, i it leh mafrechayayta — shere, vei la — asir.
Velo bekatla. may katla — menakketa pare. nezamim — nizme haaf.
Velo betabbaat sheen aleha chotam. ha yesh aleha chotam — chayyevet. alma lav tachshit hu.
Ureminhu: tachshite nashim temeim. veellu hen tachshite nashim: katlaot, nezamim vetabbaot, vetabbaat ben sheyyesh aleha chotam ben sheen aleha chotam, venizme haaf.
Veamar rabbi zera, la kashya: ha rabbi nechemya, ha rabbanan.

Detanya: hi shel mattechet vechotamah shel almog — temea, hi shel almog vechotamah shel mattechet — tehora, verabbi nechemya metamme, shehaya rabbi nechemya omer: betabbaat hallech achar chotamah. beol hallech achar simlonav.

a: Bekolav hallech achar masmerotav. besullam hallech achar shelivotav. bearsa hallech achar shalshelotav. vachachamim omrim: hakkol holech achar hammaamid.
Rava amar, litzdadim katane: yesh aleha chotam — tachshit deish, en aleha chotam — tachshit deishsha.

Rav nachman bar yitzchak amar: tumea ashshabbat karamet?! tumea, "keli maase" amar rachamana — ucheli hu. shabbat, mishshum massoy amar rachamana, en aleha chotam — tachshit, yesh aleha chotam — massoy.
Velo bemachat sheenah nekuva. lemay chazya? amar rav yosef: hoil veishsha ogeret bah searah.
Amar leh abbaye: veteheve kevirit tehora, vetishtere.

Ella targema rav adda narshaa kammeh derav yosef: hoil veishsha choleket bah searah. beshabbat lemay chazya? amar rava: tas shel zahav yesh lah al roshah. bachol choleket bah searah, beshabbat mannichatah keneged paddachtah.

Mishna lo yetze haish besandal hamesummar. velo beyachid, bizman sheen beraglo makka. velo bitfillin, velo bekamea bizman sheeno min hammumeche. velo beshiryon velo bekasda velo bemaggafayim. veim yatza — eno chayyayv chattat.
Gemara sandal hamesummar may tama?
Amar shemuel: shilfe hashshemad hayu, vehayu nechbain bimara, veamru: hannichnas — yikkanes, vehayyotze — al yetze.
Nehpach sandalo shel echad mehen, kisvurin hem echad mehen yatza verauhu oyvim veachshav bain alehen. dachaku ze baze vehargu ze et ze yoter mimma shehargu bahem oyvim.
Rabbi ilay ben elazar omer: bimara hayu yoshvin, veshamu kol meal gabbe hammeara. kisvurin hayu shebbau alehem oyvim. dachaku ze baze vehargu ze et ze yoter mimma shehargu bahen oyvim.
Rame bar yechezkel amar: bevet hakkeneset hayu yoshvin, veshamu kol meachore bet hakkeneset. kisvurin hayu shebbau alehem oyvim. dachaku ze baze vehargu ze et ze yoter mimma shehargu bahen oyvim.
Beotah shaa amru: al yetze adam besandal hamesummar. i hachi, bechol name littesar! maase ki hava — beshabbat hava. beyom tov lishtere! allema tenan:
b: Meshallechin kelim beyom tov ben tefurin ben sheenan tefurin — aval lo sandal hamesummar velo minal sheeno tafur beyom tov!
Beshabbat may tama — deikka kinnufeya, beyom tov name ikka kinnufeya. taanit tzibbur ikka kinnufeya, littesar? maase ki hava bechinnufeya deissura, hacha kinnufeya dehettera hava.

Vaafillu lerabbi chanina ben akiva, deamar: lo asru ella beyarden uvisfina uchemaase shehaya. hane mille yarden deshane mishshear neharot. aval yom tov veshabbat ki hadade ninhu, ditnan: en ben yom tov lashshabbat ella ochel nefesh bilvad.
Amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: lo shanu ella lechazzek, aval lenoy — muttar. vechamma lenoy? rabbi yochanan amar: chamesh baze vechamesh baze. verabbi chanina amar: sheva baze vesheva baze.
Amar leh rabbi yochanan lerav shemen bar abba, asbera lach: ledidi, shetayim mikkan ushetayim mikkan veachat bitresiyyotav. lerabbi chanina, shalosh mikkan veshalosh mikkan veachat bitresiyyotav.
Metivi: sandal hannote ose lo sheva, divre rabbi natan. verabbi mattir bishlosh esre.
Bishlama lerabbi chanina, hu deamar kerabbi natan. ella rabbi yochanan, deamar keman? hu deamar kerabbi nehoray, detanya: rabbi nehoray omer, chamesh muttar vesheva asur.
Amar leh efa lerabba bar bar channa: attun talmide rabbi yochanan avidu kerabbi yochanan, anan naaved kerabbi chanina.
Bea minneh rav huna merav ashe: chamesh mahu? amar leh: afillu sheva muttar. tesha may? amar leh: afillu shemone asur.
Bea minneh hahu ratzana merabbi amme: tefaro mibbifnim — mahu? amar leh: muttar, vela yadana may tama.
Amar rav ashe: vela yada mar may tama?! kevan ditfaro mibbifnim have leh minal. besandal gezaru beh rabbanan, beminal la gezaru beh rabbanan.
Bea minneh rabbi abba bar zavda merabbi abba bar avina: asao kemin kalbos, mahu? amar leh: muttar. ittemar name, amar rabbi yose berabbi chanina: asao kemin kalbos — muttar.
Amar rav sheshet: chippahu kullo bemasmerot kede shello tehe karka ochalto — muttar.

Tanya kevoteh derav sheshet: lo yetze haish besandal hamesummar, velo yetayyel mibbayit levayit, afillu mimmitta lemitta. aval metaltelin oto lechassot bo et hakkeli velismoch bo kare hammitta. verabbi elazar berabbi shimon oser. nashru rov masmerotav venishtayyeyru bo arba o chamesh — muttar. verabbi mattir ad sheva. chippahu beor millematta vekava lo masmerot millemala — muttar. asao kemin kalbos o kemin tas o kemin yated, o shechippahu kullo bemasmerot kede shello tehe karka ochalto — muttar.
Ha gufa kashya. amrat nashru rov masmerotav — af al gav denishtayyeyru beh tuva, vahadar tane: arba o chamesh — in, tefe — la!
Amar rav sheshet: la kashya — kan shennigmemu, kan shenneekru.
Arba o chamesh muttar. hasheta chamesh shere, arba mibbaya?! amar rav chisda: arba missandal katan, vechamesh missandal gadol.
Verabbi mattir ad sheva. vehatanya: rabbi mattir ad shelosh esre! note shane.
Hasheta daatet lehachi, lerabbi yochanan name la kashya: note shane.

Amar rav matna, veamri la amar rav achadvuy bar matna amar rav matna: en halacha kerabbi elazar berabbi shimon. peshita, yachid verabbim halacha kerabbim! mahu detema: mistabbera tama derabbi elazar berabbi shimon beha, ka mashma lan.

Amar rabbi chiyyay: i lav dekaru li "bavlay share issure" sharena beh tuva. vechamma? befumebdita amrin: esrin vearba. besura amrin: esrin vetarten. amar rav nachman bar yitzchak, vesimanaych: ad daata mippumebdita lesura chasar tarte.
Velo beyachid bizman sheen beraglo makka.

a: Ha yesh beraglo makka — nafek. behe minnayyhu nafek? amar rav huna: beotah sheyyesh bah makka. alma kasavar, sandal leshum tzaar avid.
Vechiyyay bar rav amar: beotah sheen bah makka. alma kasavar, leshum taanug avid, vezo sheyyesh bah makka — makkatah mochachat aleha.
Veaf rabbi yochanan savar la leha derav huna. deamar leh rabbi yochanan lerav shemen bar abba: hav li mesanay. yehav leh deyamin. amar leh asito makka.
Vedilma kechiyyay bar rav sevira leh, vehachi kaamar: asita shel semol makka.
Veazda rabbi yochanan letameh. daamar rabbi yochanan: kitfillin kach minalin. ma tefillin bismol, af minalin bismol.
Metivi: keshehu noel — noel shel yamin veachar kach noel shel semol!
Amar rav yosef: hasheta detanya hachi, veamar rabbi yochanan hachi, daavad hachi — avad, vedaavad hachi — avad.
Amar leh abbaye: dilma rabbi yochanan ha matnitin la hava shemia leh, vei hava shemia leh hava hadar beh. vei name shemia leh, vekasavar en halacha keotah mishna.

Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: yere shamayim yotze yede shetehen. umannu? — mar bereh deravna. hechi aved? — sayem deyammineh vela katar, vesayem dismaleh vekatar, vahadar katar deyammineh. amar rav ashe: chazena lerav kahana dela kafed.
Tanu rabbanan: keshehu noel — noel shel yamin veachar kach noel shel semol. keshehu choletz — choletz shel semol veachar kach choletz shel yamin.

Keshehu rochetz — rochetz shel yamin veachar kach rochetz shel semol. keshehu sach — sach shel yamin veachar kach shel semol. veharotze lasuch kol gufo — sach rosho techilla, mippene shehu melech al kol evarav.
Velo bitfillin. amar rav safra: la tema allibba deman deamar shabbat lav zeman tefillin hu. ella afillu leman deamar shabbat zeman tefillin hu — lo yetze, dilma ate leetuye birshut harabbim.

Veikka dematne la assefa: veim yatza eno chayyayv chattat. amar rav safra: la tema allibba deman deamar shabbat zeman tefillin hu, ella afillu leman deamar shabbat lav zeman tefillin hu — eno chayyayv chattat. may tama? — derech malbush avida.
Velo bekamea bizman sheeno min hammumeche. amar rav pappa: la tema ad demumeche gavra umumeche kamea, ella kevan demumeche gavra, af al gav dela mumeche kamea.
Dayka name, dekatane: "velo bekamea bizman sheeno min hammumeche", vela katane: "bizman sheeno mumeche". shema minna.
Tanu rabbanan: ezehu kamea mumeche — kol sherippe, veshana, veshillesh. echad kamea shel ketav veechad kamea shel ikkarin, echad chole sheyyesh bo sakkana veechad chole sheen bo sakkana.
Lo shennichpa, ella shello yikkafe.
Vekosher umattir afillu birshut harabbim. uvilvad shello yiksherennu
b: Besher uvetabbaat veyetze bo birshut harabbim. mishshum marit haayin.
Vehatanya: ezehu kamea mumeche — kol sherippe shelosha bene adam keechad!
La kashya: ha — limmechoye gavra, ha — limmechoye kemia.

Amar rav pappa: peshita li telata kemee litlata gavre telata telata zimne — itmachi gavra veitmachi kamea. telata kemee litlata gavre chad chad zimna — gavra itmachi, kemia la itmachi. chad kamea litlata gavre — kemia itmachi, gavra la itmachi.
Bae rav pappa: telata kemee lechad gavra may? kemia vadday la itmachi. gavra itmachi, o la itmachi? mi amrinan ha assi leh, o dilma mazzala dehay gavra hu deka mekabbel ketava. teku.

Ibbaya lehu: kemein yesh bahen mishshum kedushsha, o dilma en bahen mishshum kedushsha? lemay hilcheta? illema leatztzolinhu mippene haddeleka, ta shema: habberachot vehakkemein, af al pi sheyyesh bahen otiyyot umeinyanot harebe shebbattora — en matztzilin otan mippene haddeleka, venisrafim bimkoman!
Ella leinyan geniza. ta shema: haya katuv al yedot hakkelim veal kare hammitta — yagod veyignezennu!
Ella likkanes bahen bevet hakkisse. may? yesh bahen kedushsha — vaasir, o dilma en bahen kedushsha — ushere? ta shema velo bekamea bizman sheeno min hammumeche: ha min hammumeche — nafek.
Vei amrat kemein yesh bahen mishshum kedushsha, zimnin demitzterich levet hakkisse, veate leetoyinhu arba ammot birshut harabbim. hacha vemay askinan — bekamea shel ikkarin.
Vehatanya: echad kamea shel ketav veechad kamea shel ikkarin! ella hacha vemay askinan — bechole sheyyesh bo sakkana. vehatanya: echad chole sheyyesh bo sakkana veechad chole sheen bo sakkana.
Ella kevan demasse, af al gav denaket leh bideh — (name) shappir dame.

a: Vehatanya, rabbi oshaya omer: uvilvad shello yochazennu beyado veyaavirennu arba ammot birshut harabbim!
[Ella] hacha bemay askinan — bimchuppe or.
Vahare tefillin dimchuppot or, vetanya: hannichnas levet hakkisse — choletz tefillin berichuk arba ammot venichnas.

Hatam mishshum shin. deamar abbaye: shin shel tefillin halacha lemoshe missinay. veamar abbaye: dalet shel tefillin halacha lemoshe missinay. veamar abbaye: yod shel tefillin halacha lemoshe missinay.
Velo beshiryon velo bekasda velo bemaggafayim.
Shiryon — zarda. kasda — amar rav: sanvarta. maggafayim — amar rav: puzmake.
Mishna lo tetze ishsha bammachat hannekuva, velo betabbaat sheyyesh aleha chotam, velo becholear, velo bechovelet, velo bitzlochit shel pilyayton.
Veim yatzta — chayyevet chattat, divre rabbi meir. vachachamim potrin bechovelet uvitzlochit shel pilyayton.
Gemara amar ulla vechillufehen beish. alma kasavar ulla: kol midde dachaze leish la chaze leishsha, umiddi dachaze leishsha la chaze leish.
Metiv rav yosef: haroim yotzin besakkin. velo haroim bilvad amru, ella kol adam. ella sheddarkan shel haroim latzet besakkin.
[Ella] amar rav yosef: kasavar ulla nashim am bifne atzman hen.

Etiveh abbaye: hammotze tefillin — machnisan zug zug, echad haish veechad haishsha. vei amrat nashim am bifne atzman hen, veha mitzvat ase shehazzeman gerama hu, vechol mitzvat ase shehazzeman gerama nashim peturot?
Hatam kasavar rabbi meir: layla zeman tefillin hu, veshabbat zeman tefillin hu. have leh mitzvat ase shello hazzeman gerama, vechol mitzvat ase shello hazzeman gerama — nashim chayyayvot.
Veha hotzaa kilachar yad hi!
Amar rabbi yirmeya: baishsha gizbarit askinan. amar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan: teratzta ishsha, ish may ikka lememar?

Ella amar rava: peamim sheadam noten leishto tabbaat sheyyesh aleha chotam leholichah lakkufesa, umannichatah beyadah ad shemmaggaat lakkufesa. ufeamim shehaishsha notenet levaalah tabbaat sheen aleha chotam leholichah etzel umman letakken, umannichah beyado ad shemmaggia etzel umman.
Velo becholear velo bechovelet. may kolear? amar rav: machbanta. kovelet — amar rav: chumarta defilon. vechen amar rav assi: chumarta defilon.
Tanu rabbanan: lo tetze bechovelet, veim yatzta — chayyevet chattat, divre rabbi meir. vachachamim omrim: lo tetze, veim yatzta — petura. rabbi eliezer omer: yotza ishsha bechovelet lechattechilla.

Bemay kamippalgi? rabbi meir savar massooy hu. verabbanan savri tachshit hu, vedilma shalfa umachveya, veatya leetoyeh. verabbi eliezer savar: man dirka lemirmeh — ishsha sherechah ra, ishsha sherechah ra la shalfa umachveya, vela atya leetoyeh arba ammot birshut harabbim.
Vehatanya, rabbi eliezer poter bechovelet uvitzlochit shel pelayyton!

La kashya: ha ki kae — adderabbi meir. ha ki kae — adderabbanan. ki kae adderabbi meir deamar chayyayv chattat — amar ihu patur. ki kae adderabbanan deamri patur aval asur — amar ihu muttar lechattechilla.
b: Umay rabbi meir? detanya: lo tetze ishsha bemafteach shebbeyadah, veim yatzat — chayyevet chattat, divre rabbi meir. rabbi eliezer poter bechovelet uvitzlochit shel pilyayton.
Kovelet — man dechar shema?

Chassore michassera vehachi katane: vechen bechovelet vechen bitzlochit shel pilyayton lo tetze, veim yatza — chayyevet chattat, divre rabbi meir. rabbi eliezer poter bechovelet uvitzlochit shel pilyayton. bamme devarim amurim — kesheyyesh bahem bosem, aval en bahem bosem — chayyevet.
Amar rav adda bar ahava: zot omeret hammotzi ochalin pachot mikkeshiur bichli — chayyayv. deha en bah bosem kefachot mikkeshiur bichli dame, vekatane chayyevet.
Rav ashe amar: bealma ema lach patur, veshane hacha deleteh lemammasha kelal.
"Vereshit shemanim yimshachu", amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: ze pilyayton.
Metiv rav yosef: af al pilyayton gezar rabbi yehuda ben bava, velo hodu lo. vei amrat, mishshum taanug, ammay lo hodu lo?

Amar leh abbaye: uletamaych, ha dichtiv: "hashshotim bemizreke yayin" — rabbi amme verabbi assi, chad amar kenishkenin, vechad amar shemmezarkin kosotehen ze laze. hachi name daasir? veha rabba bar rav huna ikkela leve resh galuta veishti biknishkenin, vela amar leh vela midde!
Ella: kol midde deit beh taanug veit beh simcha — gezaru rabbanan, aval midde deit beh taanug velet beh simcha — la gezaru rabbanan.
"Hashshochvim al mittot shen useruchim al arsotam". amar rabbi yose berabbi chanina: melammed shehayu mashtinin mayim bifne mittotehen arummim.
Megaddef ba rabbi avahu: i hachi, hayeynu dichtiv: "lachen atta yiglu berosh golim" — mishshum demashtinin mayim bifne mittotehem arummim yiglu berosh golim?!
Ella amar rabbi avahu: ellu bene adam shehayu ochlim veshotim ze im ze, vedovkin mittotehen zo bazo, umachalifin neshotehen ze im ze, umasrichin arsotam beshichvat zera sheeno shellahen.
Amar rabbi avahu, veamri la bematnita tana: shelosha devarim meviin et haadam lide aniyyut, veellu hen: hammashtin mayim bifne mittato arom, umezalzel bintilat yadayim, vesheishto mekallalto befanav.
Hammashtin mayim bifne mittato arom, amar rava: la amaran ella demahdar appeh lefureyeh, aval levaray — let lan ba.
Umahdar appeh lefureyeh, name la amaran ella leara, aval bemana — let lan ba.
Umezalzel bintilat yadayim, amar rava: la amaran ella dela mesha yedeh kelal, aval mesha vela mesha — let lan ba.
Velav milleta hi, deamar rav chisda: ana meshay mele chafnay mayya vihavu li mele chafnay tevuta.
Vesheishto mekallalto befanav, amar rava: al iske tachshiteha. vehane mille hu deit leh vela aved.

Daresh rava bereh derav illae, may dichtiv: "vayyomer Adonai yaan ki gavhu benot tziyyon" — shehayu mehallechot bekoma zekufa. "vattelachna netuyot garon" — shehayu mehallechot akev betzad gudal. "umesakkerot enayim" — dahava malyan kuchela leenayyhu umerammezan. "haloch vetafof" — shehayu mehallechot arukka betzad ketzara. "uveraglehen teakkasna" — amar rav yitzchak deve rabbi amme: melammed shemmattilot mor vaafarsemon beminalehen umehallechot beshuke yerushalayim, vechevan shemmaggiot etzel bachure yisrael boatot bakkarka umattizot alehem umachnisot bahen yetzer hara keeres bechaus.

May pureanutayhi? — kiddaresh rabba bar ulla: "vehaya tachat bosem mak yihye" — makom shehayu mitbassemot bo naasa nemakim nemakim. "vetachat chagora nikpa" — makom shehayu chagurot betziltzol naasa nekafim nekafim. "vetachat maase mikshe korcha" — makom shehayu mitkashshetot bo naasa kerachim kerachim. "vetachat petigil machagoret sak" — petachim hammeviin lide gila, yihyu lemachagoret sak. "ki tachat yofi" — amar rava, hayeynu deamri inashe: challofe shufera — keva.
"Vesippach Adonai kodkod benot tziyyon" — amar rabbi yose berabbi chanina: melammed shepparcha bahen tzaraat. ketiv hacha "vesippach", uchetiv hatam: "laset velassappachat".
"VaAdonai pothen yeare". rav ushemuel, chad amar: shennishpechu kekiton, vechad amar: shennaasu pitchehen keyaar.
Amar rav yehuda amar rav: anshe yerushalayim anshe shachatz hayu. adam omer lachavero: bamme saadta hayyom? befat amila, o befat sheenah amila? beyayin gordali, o

a: Beyayin chardali? bemesav rachav, o bemesav katzar? bechaver tov, o bechaver ra? amar rav chisda: vechullan liznut.

Amar rachava amar rabbi yehuda: atze yerushalayim shel kinnamon hayu, uveshaa shehayu massikin mehen, rechan nodef bechol eretz yisrael. umishshecharva yerushalayim nignezu, velo nishtayyer ella kisora, umishtechach be gazza detzimtzemay malketa.
Mishna lo yetze haish lo besayif velo bekeshet velo bitris velo bealla velo beromach. veim yatza — chayyayv chattat.
Rabbi eliezer omer: tachshitin hen lo.
Vachachamim omrim: enan ella lignay, shenneemar: "vechittetu charvotam leittim vachanitotehem lemazmerot velo yissa goy el goy cherev velo yilmedu od milchama".
Birit — tehora veyotzin bah beshabbat.
Kevalim — temeim veen yotzin bahen beshabbat.
Gemara may bealla — kulefa.

Rabbi eliezer omer tachshitin hen lo. tanya: amru lo lerabbi eliezer: vechi meachar detachshitin hen lo, mippene ma hen betelin limot hammashiach? amar lahen: lefi sheenan tzerichin, shenneemar: "lo yissa goy el goy cherev". veteheve lenoy bealma! amar abbaye: midde dehave ashsheraga betihara.
Ufeliga dishmuel. deamar shemuel: en ben haolam hazze limot hammashiach ella shibud galuyot bilvad, shenneemar: "ki lo yechdal evyon mikkerev haaretz".
Mesayyay leh lerabbi chiyyay bar abba. deamar rabbi chiyyay bar abba: kol hanneviim lo nitnabbeu ella limot hammashiach, aval leolam habba: "ayin lo raata elohim zulatcha".

Veikka deamri: amru lo lerabbi eliezer: vechi meachar detachshitin hen lo, mippene ma hen betelin limot hammashiach? amar lahen: af limot hammashiach enan betelin. hayeynu dishmuel, ufeliga derabbi chiyyay bar abba.

Amar leh abbaye lerav dimi, veamri la lerav avya, veamri la rav yosef lerav dimi, veamri la lerav avya, veamri la abbaye lerav yosef: may tama derabbi eliezer deamar tachshitin hen lo — dichtiv: "chagor charbecha al yarech gibbor hodcha vahadarecha".
Amar leh rav kahana lemar bereh derav huna: hay bedivre tora ketiv! amar leh: en mikra yotze mide peshuto.
Amar rav kahana: kad havena bar tamne sere shenin vahava gemirna leh lechulleh talmuda, vela hava yadana deen mikra yotze midde peshuto ad hasheta. may ka mashma lan? deligmar inish vahadar lisbar.
Siman "zarot".

Amar rabbi yirmeya amar rabbi elazar: shene talmide chachamim hamechaddedin ze leze bahalacha hakkadosh baruch hu matzliach lahem, shenneemar: "vahadarcha tzelach". al tikre: "vahadarcha", ella "vachadadcha". velo od ella sheolin ligdulla, shenneemar: "tzelach rechav". yachol afillu shello lishmah — talmud lomar: "al devar emet". yachol im heges dato — talmud lomar: "veanva tzedek". veim osin ken zochin lattora shennittena beyamin, shenneemar: "vetorcha noraot yeminecha".

Rav nachman bar yitzchak amar: zochin lidvarim shenneemru biminah shel tora. deamar rava bar rav shela, veamri la amar rav yosef bar chama amar rav sheshet: may dichtiv "orech yamim biminah bismolah osher vechavod" — ella biminah orech yamim ikka, osher vechavod lekka?! ella: lammayyminin bah — orech yamim ikka, vechol shekken osher vechavod. lammasmeilim bah — osher vechavod ikka, orech yamim lekka.

Amar rabbi yirmeya amar rabbi shimon ben lakish: shene talmide chachamim hannochin ze laze bahalacha hakkadosh baruch hu makshiv lahen, shenneemar: "az nidberu yire Adonai vegomer" — en dibbur ella nachat, shenneemar: "yadber ammim tachtenu".
May "ulechoshve shemo"? amar rabbi amme: afillu chishshev laasot mitzva, veneenas velo asaah, maale alav hakkatuv keillu asaah.
Amar rav chinnana bar idi: kol haose mitzva kemaamarah en mevasserin oto besorot raot, shenneemar: "shomer mitzva lo yeda davar ra".

Amar rav assi, veittema rabbi chanina: afillu hakkadosh baruch hu gozer gezera — hu mevattelah, shenneemar: "baasher devar melech shilton umi yomar lo ma taase", usemich leh: "shomer mitzva lo yeda davar ra".

Amar rabbi abba amar rabbi shimon ben lakish: shene talmide chachamim hammakshivim ze laze bahalacha hakkadosh baruch hu shomea lekolan, shenneemar: "hayyoshevet baggannim chaverim makshivim lekolech hashemiini".
Veim en osin ken — gormin lashshechina shemmistalleket miyyisrael, shenneemar: "berach dodi udeme vegomer".

Amar rabbi abba amar rabbi shimon ben lakish: shene talmide chachamim hammadgilim ze laze bahalacha hakkadosh baruch hu ohavan, shenneemar: "vediglo alay ahava". amar rava: vehu deyadi tzureta dishmata. vehu delet lehu rabba bemata lemigmar minneh.
Amar rabbi abba amar rabbi shimon ben lakish: gadol hammalve yoter min haose tzedaka. umetil bakkis, yoter mikkullan.
Amar rabbi abba amar rabbi shimon ben lakish: im talmid chacham nokem venoter kenachash hu — chogrehu al motnecha. im am haaretz hu chasid — al tadur bishchunato.

Amar rav kahana amar rabbi shimon ben lakish, veamri la amar rav assi amar resh lakish, veamri la amar rabbi abba amar rabbi shimon ben lakish: kol hamegaddel kelev ra betoch beto monea chesed mittoch beto, shenneemar: "lammas
b: Mereehu chased" — shekken belashon yevanit korin lechelev "lammas". rav nachman bar yitzchak amar: af porek mimmennu yirat shamayim, shenneemar "veyirat shadday yaazov".

Hahi itteta daayayla lehahu beta lemefa. nevach bah kalba, itakar valda. amar la mare deveta la tidchali, dishkili niveh ushekilin tufereh. amara leh: shekila tevutaych veshadya achizre, kevar nad valad.

Amar rav huna: may dichtiv: "semach bachur beyaldutecha vitivcha libbecha bime vechurotecha vehallech bedarche libbecha uvemare enecha veda ki al kol elle yeviacha haelohim bammishpat" — ad kan divre yetzer hara, mikkan veelach divre yetzer tov.
Resh lakish amar: ad kan ledivre tora, mikkan veelach lemaasim tovim.
Birit tehora. amar rav yehuda: birit zo etzada.
Metiv rav yosef: birit tehora veyotze bah beshabbat, veillu etzada temea hi!
Hachi kaamar: birit tachat etzada omedet.
Yatev ravin verav huna kammeh derav yirmeya, veyatev rav yirmeya veka menamnem. veyatev ravin vekaamar: — birit beachat, kevalim bishtayim.
Amar leh rav huna: ellu veellu bishtayim, umetilin shalshelet benehen venaasu kevalim.
Veshalshelet shebbo meshavveya leh mana?

Vechi tema kerabbi shemuel bar nachmani, deamar rabbi shemuel bar nachmani amar rabbi yochanan: minnayin lemashmia kol bichle mattachot shehu tame — shenneemar: "kol davar asher yavo vaesh" — afillu dibbur bammashma.
Bishlama hatam — ka vau la lekala, vekaaved maase, hacha may maase kaaved?

Hacha name ka aved maase, deamar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan: mishpacha achat hayta birushalayim shehayu pesiotehen gassot vehayu betulotehen noshrot, asu lahen kevalim vehetilu shalshelet benehen, shello yihyu pesiotehen gassot velo hayu betulotehen noshrot. ittear behu rabbi yirmeya, amar lehu: yishar, vechen amar rabbi yochanan.
Ki ata rav dimi amar rabbi yochanan: minnayin learig kol shehu shehu tame — mitztzitz.
Amar leh abbaye: vetzitz arig hu?! vehatanya: tzitz kemin tas shel zahav, verochav shete etzbaot, umukkaf meozen leozen, vechatuv alav bishte shitin: "yod he" lemala, vekodesh lamed" lematta.
Veamar rabbi eliezer berabbi yose: ani reitiv beromi vechatuv alav "kodesh laAdonai" beshita achat.

Ki selek rav dimi linhardea shelach lehu: devarim sheamarti lachem taut hem beyadi, beram kach amru mishshum rabbi yochanan: minnayin letachshit kol shehu shehu tame — mitztzitz. uminnayin learig kol shehu shehu tame: — meo veged".
Tanu rabbanan: arig kol shehu — tame, vetachshit kol shehu — tame. arig vetachshit kol shehu — tame. musaf sak al habbeged shettame mishshum arig.
Amar rava: arig kol shehu tame — meo veged". tachshit kol shehu tame — mitztzitz. arig vetachshit kol shehu tame — mikkol keli maase".
Amar leh hahu merabbanan lerava: hahu bemidyan ketiv!
Amar leh: gamar

a: "Keli" "keli" mehatam.

Musaf sak al habbeged shettame mishshum arig. attu beged lav arig hu?! hachi kaamar: musaf sak al habbeged, af al pi sheeno arig — tame. lemay chaze? amar rabbi yochanan: shekken ani kolea shalosh nimin vetola betzavvar bitto.

Tanu rabbanan: "sak" — en li ella sak, minnayin lerabbot et hakkilkeli veet hachavak — talmud lomar: "o sak". yachol sheani merabbe et hachavalim veet hammeshichot — talmud lomar: "sak". ma sak tevivy vearig — af kol tevivy vearig.
Hare hu omer bemet: "vechol keli or vechol maase izzim vegomer titchattau" — lerabbot hakkilkeli veet hachavak.

Yachol sheani merabbe et hachavalim veet hammeshichot? vedin hu: timme bashsheretz, vetimme bammet. ma keshettimme bashsheretz — lo timme ella tevivy vearig, af keshettimme bammet — lo timme ella tevivy vearig.
Hen im hekel betumeat sheretz shehi kalla, nakel betumeat hammet shehi chamura?! — talmud lomar "beged" vaor" "beged" vaor" ligzera shava.
Neemar "beged" vaor" besheretz veneemar "beged" vaor" bemet. ma beged vaor haamur besheretz — lo timme ella tevivy vearig, af beged vaor haamur bemet — lo timme ella tevivy vearig.
Uma beged vaor haamur bemet — timme kol maase izzim, af beged vaor haamur besheretz — timme kol maase izzim.
En li ella davar habba min haizzim, minnayin lerabbot davar habba mizzenav hassus umizzenav happara? — talmud lomar: "o sak".
Veha appekteh lekilkeli vachavak?
Hane mille mikkamme detete gezera shava, hasheta deatya gezera shava iyyaytar leh.
Veen li ella besheretz, betumeat met minnayin?

Vedin hu: timme bemet vetimme besheretz. ma keshettimme besheretz — asa davar habba mizzenav hassus umizzenav happara kemaase izzim, af keshettimme bemet — asa davar habba mizzenav hassus umizzenav happara kemaase izzim.
Hen im ribba betumeat erev shehi merubba, nerabbe betumeat shiva shehi muetet?!

Talmud lomar: "beged" vaor" "beged" vaor" ligzera shava. neemar "beged" vaor" besheretz, veneemar "beged" vaor" bemet. ma "beged" vaor" haamur besheretz — asa davar habba mizzenav hassus umizzenav happara kemaase izzim, af "beged" vaor" haamur bemet — asa davar habba mizzenav hassus umizzenav happara kemaase izzim.
Umufene. dei lav mufene, ikka lemifrach: ma lesheretz shekken metamme bechaadasha?!

Laye ippenoye mufene. mikkede sheretz ittakkash leshichvat zera, dichtiv: "ish asher tetze mimmennu shichvat zara", usemich leh: "ish asher yigga bechol sheretz", uchetiv beh beshichvat zera: "vechol beged vechol or asher yihye alav shichvat zara" — "beged" vaor" dichtav rachamana besheretz lema li? shema minna leafnoye.
Veakkatti mufene mitztzad echad hu. hanicha leman deamar mufene mitztzad echad lemedin veen meshivin. ella leman deamar lemedin umeshivin, may ikka lememar?

Demet name ippenoye mufene: mikkedi met ittakkash leshichvat zera, dichtiv: "vehannogea bechol teme nefesh o ish asher tetze mimmennu shichvat zara", uchetiv beshichvat zera: "vechol beged vechol or" — "beged" vaor" dichtav rachamana bemet lema li? — shema minna leafnoye.
"Vannakrev et korban Adonai ish asher matza cheli zahav etzada vetzamid tabbaat agil vechumaz". amar rabbi elazar: "agil" — ze defus shel daddin. "kumaz" — ze defus shel bet harechem.
Amar rav yosef: i hachi, hayeynu dimtargeminan "machoch" — davar hammevi lide gichuch. amar leh rabba: miggufeh dikra shema minna, "kumaz" — kan mekom zimma.

"Vayyiktzof moshe al pekude hechayil". amar rav nachman amar rabba bar avu: amar lahen moshe leyisrael, shemma chazartem lekilkulechem harishon? amru lo: "lo nifkad mimmennu ish". amar lahen: im ken kappara lamma? amru lo: im mide avera yatzanu, mide hirhur lo yatzanu! miyyad "vannakrev et korban Adonai".
Tana deve rabbi yishmael: mippene ma hutzerchu yisrael shebbeoto haddor kappara — mippene
b: Shezzanu enehem min haerva.
Amar rav sheshet: mippene ma mana hakkatuv tachshitin shebbachutz im tachshitin shebbifnim? — lomar lach: kol hammistakkel beetzba ketanna shel ishsha keillu mistakkel bimkom hatturepa.
Mishna yotza ishsha bechute sear, ben mishshellah ben mishshel chavertah ben mishshel behema.
Uvetotefet, uvesarbitin bizman shehen tefurin.
Bechavul uvefea nochrit lechatzer. bemoch shebbeoznah, uvemoch shebbesandalah, uvemoch shehitkina leniddatah.
Befilpel, uvegalgal melach, vechol davar shennittan letoch piha, uvilvad shello titten lechattechilla beshabbat, veim nafal — lo tachazir.
Shen totevet, shen shel zahav — rabbi mattir, vachachamim osrim.
Gemara utzericha, dei ashmeinan dida mishshum dela meis, aval chaverta dimis — ema la.
Vei ashmeinan dachaverta — devat mina hu, aval divhema lav bar mina hu ema la, tzericha.
Tana: uvilvad shello tetze yalda beshel zekena uzekena beshel yalda.
Bishlama zekena beshel yalda — shevach hu lah. ella yalda beshel zekena ammay? genay hu lah! ayyeydi ditna zekena beshel yalda, tena name yalda beshel zekena.
Bechavul uvefea nochrit lechatzer. amar rav: kol sheasru chachamim latzet bo lirshut harabbim, asur latzet bo lechatzer — chutz mikkavul ufea nochrit.
Rabbi anani bar sason mishshemeh derabbi yishmael amar: hakkol kechavul.

Tenan: bechavul uvefea nochrit lechatzer. bishlama lerav — nicha, ella lerabbi anani bar sason kashya! rabbi anani bar sason mishshemeh deman kaamar leh? — mishshemeh derabbi yishmael bar yose, rabbi yishmael bar yose tanna hu ufelig.

Verav, may shena hane? amar ulla: kede shello titganne al balah. kidtanya: "vehaddava beniddatah" — zekenim harishonim amru shello tichchol velo tifkos velo titkashshet bevigde tzivonin, ad shebba rabbi akiva velimmed: im ken — atta megannah al balah, venimtza balah megarshah. ella ma talmud lomar: "vehaddava beniddatah" — beniddatah tehe ad shettavo bammayim.
Amar rav yehuda amar rav: kol makom sheasru chachamim mippene marit haayin — afillu bechadre chadarim asur.
Tenan: velo bezog af al pi sheppakuk. vetanya iddach: pokek lah zog betzavvarah umetayyel immah bechatzer.
Tannae hi, detanya:

a: Shotchan bachamma, aval lo keneged haam. rabbi eliezer verabbi shimon osrin.
Uvemoch shebbeoznah. tane rame bar yechezkel: vehu shekkashur beoznah.
Uvemoch shebbesandalah. tane rame bar yechezkel: vehu shekkashur lah besandalah.
Uvemoch shehitkina lah leniddatah. savar rame bar chama lememar, vehu shekkashur lah ben yerechoteha. amar rava: af al pi sheeno kashur lah, kevan dimis la atya leetoye.
Bea minneh rabbi yirmeya merabbi abba: asta lah bet yad, mahu? amar leh: muttar. ittemar [name], amar rav nachman bar oshaya amar rabbi yochanan: asta lah bet yad — muttar.

Rabbi yochanan nafek behu leve midresha, vachalukin alav chaverav. rabbi yannay nafek behu lecharmelit, vachalukin alav kol doro. vehatane rame bar yechezkel: vehu shekkashur lah beoznah! la kashya: ha demihaddak, ha dela mihaddak.
Bappilpel uvegalgal melach. pilpel lereach happe, galgal melach ledureshinne. vechol davar shennotenet letoch piha. zangevila, i name dartzuna.

Shen totevet shen shel zahav, rabbi mattir vachachamim osrin. amar rabbi zera lo shanu ella shel zahav, aval beshel kesef divre hakkol muttar. tanya name hachi: beshel kesef divre hakkol muttar. shel zahav, rabbi mattir vachachamim osrin.
Amar abbaye: rabbi verabbi eliezer verabbi shimon ben elazar kullehu sevira lehu dechol midde demigganneya beh la atya leachvoye.
Rabbi — ha daamaran. rabbi eliezer — detanya: rabbi eliezer poter bechovelet uvitzlochit shel pilyayton.
Rabbi shimon ben elazar — detanya, kelal amar rabbi shimon ben elazar: kol shehu lematta min hassevacha yotza bo, lemala min hassevacha — enah yotza bo.

Mishna yotza besela sheal hatztzinnit. habbanot ketannot yotzot bechutin, vaafillu bekesamin shebbeoznehem. arviyyot yotzot reulot umadiyyot perufot, vechol adam — ella sheddibberu chachamim bahove. porefet al haeven veal haegoz veal hammatbea, uvilvad shello tifrof lechattechilla beshabbat.
Gemara may tzinnit? bat ara.
Umay shena sela? illema kol midde daakosha mealle la, lebad la chaspa! ella mishshum shucheta — lebad lah tassa! ella mishshum tzureta, lebad lah pulesa! amar abbaye: shema minna kullehu meallu lah.
Habbanot yotzot bechutin. avu dishmuel la shavek lehu livnateh denafkan bechutin, vela shavek lehu ganyan gabbe hadade, veaved lehu mikvaot beyome nisan umappatze beyome tishre.
La shavek lehu yotzot bechutin, vehaanan tenan: habbanot yotzot bechutin! benateh daavu dishmuel detzivonin havo.
La shavek lehu ganyan gabbe hadade, lema mesayyay leh lerav huna. deamar rav huna: nashim hamesollot zo bazo
b: Pesulot lakkehunna.
La — savar ki hechi dela lelfan gufa nucheraa.
Veaved lehu mikve beyome nisan, mesayyay leh lerav, deamar rav: mitra bemareva sahada rabba perat. savar, shello yirbu hannotfin al hazzochalin.
Ufeliga dishmuel. deamar shemuel: nahara mikkefeh mibbarach. ufeliga dideh addideh, deamar shemuel: en hammayim metaharin bezochalin ella perat beyome tishre bilvad.
Porefet al haeven kulei. vehaamrat resha "porefet"? amar abbaye: sefa atan lematbea.
Bae abbaye: ishsha mahu shettaarim vetifrof al haegoz lehotzi livnah katan beshabbat?
Tibbee leman deamar maarimin. tibbee leman deamar en maarimin.
Tibbee leman deamar maarimin bidleka: hatam hu dei la sharet leh ate lechabboye, aval hacha i la sharet leh la ate leappoke.
O dilma, afillu leman deamar en maarimin bidleka, hatam — derech hotzaa bechach, aval hacha — en derech hotzaa bechach, ema shappir dame. teku.
Mishna hakkittea yotze bekav shello — divre rabbi meir,

a: Verabbi yose oser.
Veim yesh lo bet kibbul ketitin — tame.
Samochot shello temein midras, veyotzin bahen beshabbat, venichnasin bahen baazara.
Kisse vesamochot shello temein midras, veen yotzin bahen beshabbat, veen nichnasin bahen baazara.
Lukatmin tehorin, veen yotzin bahen.
Gemara amar leh rava lerav nachman: hechi tenan? amar leh: la yadana. hilcheta may? amar leh: la yadana.
Ittemar, amar shemuel: "en hakkittea", vechen amar rav huna: "en hakkittea". amar rav yosef: hoil veamar shemuel "en hakkittea" veamar rav huna "en hakkittea" — anan name nitne "en hakkittea".

Matkif la rava bar shira: la shemia lehu ha dematne leh rav chanan bar rava lechiyyay bar rav kammeh derav bekitona deve rav? en hakkittea yotze bekav shello — divre rabbi meir, verabbi yose mattir. umachve leh rav: efoch. amar rav nachman bar yitzchak, vesimana: "samech" "samech".
Veaf shemuel hadar beh. ditnan: chaltza besandal sheeno shello, besandal shel etz, o shel semol beyamin — chalitza keshera.
Veamrinan: man tanna? amar shemuel: rabbi meir hi, ditnan: hakkittea yotze bekav shello — divre rabbi meir, rabbi yose oser.
Veaf rav huna hadar beh, detanya: sandal shel sayyaydin tame midras, veishsha choletzet bo, veyotzin bo beshabbat — divre rabbi akiva, velo hodu lo.
Vehatanya "hodu lo"! amar rav huna: man "hodu lo" — rabbi meir, uman "lo hodu lo" — rabbi yose.
Amar rav yosef: man "lo hodu lo" — rabbi yochanan ben nuri. ditnan: kavveret shel kash ushefoferet shel kanim — rabbi akiva metamme, verabbi yochanan ben nuri metaher.
Amar mar: sandal shel sayyaydin tame midras. ha lav lehillucha avid! amar rav acha bar rav ulla: shekken hassayyayd metayyel bo ad shemmaggia leveto.
Veim yesh lo bet kibbul ketitin — tame. amar abbaye: tame tumeat met, veen tame midras. rava amar: af tame midras.
Amar rava: mena amena la — ditnan: agala shel katan — temea midras. veabbaye amar: hatam samech illaveh, hacha la samech illaveh.
Amar abbaye: mena amena la — detanya: makkel shel zekenim tahor mikkelum!
Verava: hatam
b: Letarotze sugeya avida, hacha — lismoch illaveh hu daavida, vesamech aleh.
Temein midras, veen yotzin bahen beshabbat, veen nichnasin bahen laazara.
Tane tanna kammeh derabbi yochanan: "nichnasin bahen laazara".
Amar leh: ani shone "ishsha choletzet bo", veat amrat "nichnasin"?! teni "en nichnasin bahen laazara".
Lukatmin tehora. may lukatmin? amar rabbi avahu: chamara deakkappa. rava bar pappa amar: kishre. rava bar rav huna amar: perame.
Mishna habbanim yotzin biksharim uvene melachim bezogin, vechol adam — ella sheddibberu chachamim bahove.
Gemara may kesharim? amar adda mari amar rav nachman bar baruch amar rav ashe bar avin amar rav yehuda: kishshure fua.
Amar abbaye, amara li em: telata — mokmi, chamishsha — massu, shiva — afillu lichshafim meallu.
Amar rav acha bar yaakov: vehu dela chazi leh shimsha vesehara, vela chazi mitra, vela shemia leh kal barzela, vekal tarnugela, vekal nigre. amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: nefal puta bevera.
May irya banim? afillu banot name! may irya ketannim? afillu gedolim name!

Ella may kesharim — ki ha deamar avin bar huna amar rabbi chama bar gureya: ben sheyyesh lo gaguin al aviv — notel retzua mimminal shel yamin vekosher lo bismolo. amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: vesimanaych — tefillin, vechillufa sakkanta.
Amar avin bar huna amar rav chama bar gureya: sachofe kasa attibbure beshabbeta — shappir dame.
Veamar avin bar huna amar rav chama bar gureya: muttar lasuch shemen umelach beshabbat.

Ki ha derav huna mibbe rav, verav mibbe rabbi chiyyay, verabbi chiyyay mibbe rabbi, ki havo mibbassemi mayytu mishcha umilcha, veshayyfi lehu legavvayayta didayyhu vegavvayayta decharayyhu, veamri: "ki hechi detzayel ha mishcha letzil chamreh diflanya bar pelanita". vei la — mayyte shia dedanna veshare leh bemayya, veamar: "ki hechi detzayel hay shia letzil chamreh diflanya bar pelanita".
Veamar avin bar huna amar rav chama bar gureya: muttar lechanek beshabbat.
Veamar avin bar huna amar rav chama bar gureya: lappofe yanoka beshabbeta — shappir dame.

Rav pappa matne "banim", rav zevid matne "ben". rav pappa matne "banim", vetarvayyhu matne lehu beavin bar huna. rav zevid matne "ben" — kammayyta matne beavin bar huna, vehay matne la berabba bar bar chana. deamar rabba bar bar chana: lappofe yanoka beshabbeta — shappir dame.
Amar abbaye, amara li em: kol minyayne — bishma deimma, vechol kitre — bismala.
Veamar abbaye, amara li em: kol minyayne demipparshi — kidmipparshi, udela mipparshi — arbein vechad zimne.

Tanu rabbanan: yotzin beeven tekuma beshabbat. mishshum rabbi meir amru: af bemishkal even tekuma. velo shehippila, ella shemma tappil. velo sheibbera, ella shemma titabber vetappil. amar rav yemar bar shelemya mishshemeh deabbaye: vehu deikkavvavn veittekal. bae abbaye: mishkal demishkal may? teku.
Veamar abbaye, amara li em: leishshata bat yoma — lishkol zuza chiuora, velezil lemilchata, velitkol matkaleh milcha, velitzyeyreh bachalala deve tzavvar benira barka.

Vei la — littev apparashat derachim, vechi chaze shumeshmana gamla dedare midde, lishkeleh velishdeyeh beguveta dinchasha, velistemeh baavara, velichtemeh beshittin gushepanke, ulevarzoleh, velidreh, velema leh: "teunach alay uteunay alach". amar leh rav acha bereh derav huna lerav ashe: vedilma inish ashkecheh veippesik beh? ella lema leh: "teunay uteunach alach".

Vei la, lishkol kuza chadta, velezil lenahra, velema leh: "nahara nahara, ozfan kuza demayya leorcha deikkela li". velayhdar shav zimne al resheh, velishdeyeh laachoreh, velema leh: "nahara nahara, shekol mayya dihavt li, deorcha deikkela li beyomeh ata uveyomeh azal".
Amar rav huna:

a: Leishshata tilta — layyte shiva silve mishshiva dikle, veshiva tzive mishshiva keshure, veshiva sikke mishshiva geshure, veshiva kitme mishshiva tannure, veshiva afre mishshiva sunre, veshiva kufere mishshiva arve, veshiva bune kammone, veshiva bine middikna dechalba sava, velitzyeyrinhu bachalala deve tzavvera benira barka.
Amar rabbi yochanan: leishshata tzemirta — lishkol sakkina dechulle parzela, velezil lehecha deikka vavrdina, veliktar beh nira barka.

Yoma kamma, lichrok beh pureta velema: "vayyera malach Adonai elav vegomer". limchar, lichrok beh pureta velema: "vayyomer moshe asura na veere". limchar, lichrok beh pureta velema: "vayyar Adonai ki sar lirot vegomer".

Amar leh rav acha bereh derava lerav ashe, velema: "vayyomer al tikrav halom vegomer"? ella leyoma kamma, lema: "vayyera malach Adonai elav vegomer vayyomer moshe vegomer", velimchar, lema: "vayyar Adonai ki sar lirot", velimchar: "vayyomer Adonai al tikrav halom".

Vechi pasek leh, litatteh velifsekeh velema hachi: "hassene hassene! lav mishshum digvihat mikkol ilane ashri kudesha berich hu shechinteh alach, ella mishshum demayychat mikkol ilane ashri kudesha berich hu shechinteh alach. vechi hechi dachamiteh ishshata lachananya mishael vaazarya vaarakat min kodamohi, ken tichmeneh ishshata lifloni bar pelonit vetirok min kodamohi".

Lesimta, lema hachi: "baz, bazyay, mas, masyay, kas, kasyay, shirlay, vaamarlay, illen malache deishtelachu meara disdom uleassaa shechina keivin, bezach, bazayich, bazbezich, masmesich, kammon, kamich, enich bich, enich bich, atrich bich, zarich kekalut uchefirda dela para vela ravya, kach la tifre vela tirbe begufeh difloni bar pelonit".
Lechippa, lema hachi: "cherev shelufa vekela netusha la shemeh yochav cholin machovin".
Lesheda, lema hachi: "havet difkik, difkik havet, lit tevir umeshummat bar tit bar tame bar tina, keshamgaz merigaz veistemay".
Lesheda devet hakkisse, lema hachi: "akkarkafe daari veaose degurayyta ashkachtun lesheday bar sherika panda, bemeshara decharate chavatteh, beloa dachamara chatarteh".
Uvene melachim bezogin. man tanna? amar rabbi oshaya: rabbi shimon hi, deamar: kol yisrael bene melachim hem. rava amar: bearig bichsuto, vedivre hakkol.
Mishna yotzin bevetzat hachargol uveshen shual uvemasmer min hatztzaluv, mishshum refua — divre rabbi meir. vachachamim osrin af bachol, mishshum darche haemori.
Gemara yotzin bevetzat hachargol — deavdi leshichla. uveshen shel shual — deavdi leshinta. dechayyay — leman denayem. demita — leman dela nayem. uvemasmer min hatztzaluv — deavdi lezirpa.
Mishshum refua — divre rabbi meir.
Abbaye verava deamri tarvayyhu: kol davar sheyyesh bo mishshum refua en bo mishshum darche haemori.

Ha en bo mishshum refua yesh bo mishshum darche haemori? vehatanya: ilan shemmashshir perotav sokro vetzovea oto besikra vetoano baavanim. bishlama toano baavanim, ki hechi delichchosh cheleh. ella sokro besikra may refua kaaved?

Ki hechi delichzeyu inashe velivo aleh rachame. kidtanya: "vetame tame yikra". tzarich lehodia tzaaro lerabbim, verabbim yevakkeshu alav rachamim. amar ravina: keman talenan kuvese bedikla — ki hay tanna.

Tane tanna beferek emorae kammeh derabbi chiyyay bar avin. amar leh: kullehu it behu mishshum darche haemori, levar mehane: mi sheyyesh lo etzem bigrono mevi meoto hammin umanniach leh al kodkodo, velema hachi: "chad chad nachet bala, bala nachet chad chad", en bo mishshum darche haemori.
Leiddera lema hachi: "ninneatzta kemachat, ninalleta kitris, shayyay shayyay".
b: Haomer "gad gaddi, usenuk la ashki uvusheki" — yesh bo mishshum darche haemori. rabbi yehuda omer: "gad" eno ella leshon avoda zara, shenneemar: "haorchim laggad shulchan".
Hu bishmah vehi bishmo — yesh bo mishshum darche haemori.
"Dunu dannay" — yesh bo mishshum darche haemori. rabbi yehuda omer: en "dan" ella leshon avoda zara, shenneemar: "hannishbaim beashmat shomron veamru che elohecha dan".
Haomer leorev "tzerach", uleorevta "sheriki vehachaziri li zenavich letova" — yesh bo mishshum darche haemori.
Haomer "shachatu tarnegol ze shekkara arvit" vetarnegolet shekkara gavrit" — yesh bo mishshum darche haemori.
"Eshte veotir, eshte veotir" — yesh bo mishshum darche haemori.
Hamevakkaat betzim bakkotel, vehattach bifne haefrochim — yesh bo mishshum darche haemori.
Vehammegis bifne efrochim — yesh bo mishshum darche haemori.
Hamerakkedet, vehammona shivim veechad efrochin bishvil shello yamutu — yesh bo mishshum darche haemori.
Hamerakkedet lechuttach, vehameshatteket laadashim, vehametzavvavchat ligrisin — yesh bo mishshum darche haemori.
Hammashtenet bifne kederatah bishvil shettitbashshel mehera — yesh bo mishshum darche haemori.
Aval notnin kesam shel tut veshivre zechuchit bikdera bishvil shettitbashshel mehera, vachachamim osrin beshivre zechuchit mippene hassakkana.
Tanu rabbanan: notnin bul shel melach letoch hanner bishvil shettair vetadlik. venotnin tit vecharsit tachat hanner bishvil shettamtin vetadlik.
Amar rav zutera: hay man dimchasse sheraga demishcha umegalle nafta kaavar mishshum "bal tashchit".

"Chamra vechayye lefum rabbanan" — en bo mishshum darche haemori. maase berabbi akiva sheasa mishte livno, veal kol kos vachos shehevi amar: "chamra vechayye lefum rabbanan, chayye vechamra lefum rabbanan ulefum talmidehon".
Haderan alach bema ishsha

Mishna kelal gadol amru beshabbat: kol hashshocheach ikkar shabbat, veasa melachot harebe beshabbatot harebe — eno chayyayv ella chattat achat. hayyodea ikkar shabbat, veasa melachot harebe beshabbatot harebe — chayyayv al kol shabbat veshabbat. hayyodea shehu shabbat, veasa melachot harebe beshabbatot harebe — chayyayv al kol

a: Av melacha umelacha. haose melachot harebe meen melacha achat, eno chayyayv ella chattat achat.

Gemara may tama tena "kelal gadol"? illema mishshum dekavae lemitne: "od kelal acher amru", tena "kelal gadol". vegabbe sheviit name, mishshum dekavae lemitne: "od kelal acher amru", tena "kelal gadol". veha gabbe maaser, dekatane: "kelal acher amru", vela tane "kelal gadol"!

Amar rabbi yose bar avin: shabbat usheviit deit behu avot vetoladot — tena "gadol", maaser delet be avot vetoladot, la tena "kelal gadol". ulevar kappara, detane "kelal gadol" bemaaser, may avot umay toladot ikka?

Ella lav hayeynu tama, gadol onshah shel shabbat yoter mishshel sheviit, deillu shabbat ita ben betalush ben bimchubbar, veillu sheviit betalush leta bimchubbar ita. vegadol onshah shel sheviit yoter min hammaaser, deillu sheviit ita ben bemaachal adam ben bemaachal behema, veillu maaser bemaachal adam ite bemaachal behema lete.

Ulevar kappara detane "kelal gadol" bammaaser: gadol onsho shel maaser yoter mishshel pea, deillu maaser ite bitena veyarak veillu pea leta bitena veyarak. ditnan, kelal amru bappea: kol shehu ochel venishmar vegiddulo min haaretz ulekitato keachat umachniso lekiyyum — chayyayv befea.
Ochel — lemaote sefiche setis vekotza. venishmar — lemaote hefker. vegiddulo min haaretz — lemaote kemehin ufitriyyot. ulekitato keachat — lemaote teena. umachniso lekiyyum — lemaote yarak.
Veillu gabbe maaser tenan, kelal amru bammaaser: kol shehu ochel venishmar vegiddulo min haaretz — chayyayv bemaaser. veillu lekitato keachat umachniso lekiyyum la tenan.

Rav ushemuel deamri tarvayyhu: matnitin betinok shennishba leven haggoyim, veger shennitgayyer leven haggoyim. aval hikkir ulevassof shachach — chayyayv al kol shabbat veshabbat. tenan: "hashshocheach ikkar shabbat", lav mikkelal dehavya leh yedia meikkara?! la, may "kol hashshocheach ikkar shabbat" — shehayta shechucha mimmennu ikkarah shel shabbat.

Aval hikkir ulevassof shachach may — chayyayv al kol shabbat veshabbat? addetane hayyodea ikkar shabbat veasa melachot harebe beshabbatot harebe chayyayv al kol shabbat veshabbat, litne "hikkir ulevassof shachach", vechol shekken ha! may "hayyodea ikkar shabbat" — mi shehaya yodea ikkarah shel shabbat ushechechah.
b: Aval lo shechechah, may — chayyayv al kol melacha umelacha? addetane hayyodea shehu shabbat veasa melachot harebe beshabbatot harebe chayyayv al kol melacha umelacha, litne "hayyodea ikkar shabbat", vechol shekken ha! ella, matnitin keshehikkir ulevassof shachach, uderav ushemuel name kehikkir ulevassof shachach dame. vehachi ittemar: rav ushemuel deamri tarvayyhu afillu tinok shennishba ben haggoyim veger shennitgayyer leven haggoyim — kehikkir ulevassof shachach dame, vechayyayv.

Verabbi yochanan verabbi shimon ben lakish deamri tarvayyhu: davka hikkir ulevassof shachach — aval tinok shennishba ben haggoyim veger shennitgayyer leven haggoyim — patur. metivi: kelal gadol amru bashshabbat: kol hashshocheach ikkar shabbat, veasa melachot harebe beshabbatot harebe — eno chayyayv ella achat. ketzad? — tinok shennishba leven haggoyim, veger shennitgayyer ben haggoyim, veasa melachot harebe beshabbatot harebe — eno chayyayv ella chattat achat. vechayyayv al haddam achat, veal hachelev achat, veal avoda zara achat, umonbaz poter.

Vechach haya monbaz dan lifne rabbi akiva: hoil umezid karuy "chote" veshogeg karuy "chote", ma mezid shehayta lo yedia — af shogeg shehayta lo yedia. amar lo rabbi akiva, hareni mosif al devarecha: i ma mezid shehayta hayyedia bishat maase — af shogeg shehayta lo yedia bishat maase!
Amar lo: hen, vechol shekken shehosafta. amar lo: lidvarecha, en ze karuy shogeg ella mezid.

Katane miha "ketzad tinok". bishlama lerav ushemuel nicha. ella lerabbi yochanan ulerabbi shimon ben lakish, kashya! amri lach rabbi yochanan veresh lakish: la mi ikka monbaz defatar? anan deamrinan kemonbaz.

May tama demonbaz? dichtiv: "tora achat yihye lachem laose bishgaga", usemich leh "vehannefesh asher taase beyad rama" — hikkish shogeg lemezid. ma mezid shehayta lo yedia, af shogeg shehayta lo yedia.
Verabbanan, hay "tora achat" may avdi leh? mibbee lehu lechidmakre leh rabbi yehoshua ben levi livreh: "tora achat yihye lachem laose bishgaga", uchetiv:

a: "Vechi tishgu velo taasu et kol hammitzvot haelle", uchetiv: "vehannefesh asher taase beyad rama". hukeshu kullam laavoda zara: ma lehallan davar shechayyayvim al zedono karet veshiggato chattat, af kol davar shechayyayvin al zedono karet veal shiggato chattat.
Veella monbaz, shegaga bemay? kegon sheshshagag bekorban. verabbanan: shiggat korban lo shemah shegaga.

Verabbanan, shegaga bemay? rabbi yochanan amar: kevan sheshshagag becharet, af al pi shehezid belav. veresh lakish amar ad sheyyishgog belav vecharet. amar rava: may tama derabbi shimon ben lakish — amar kera: "asher lo teasena bishgaga veashem" — ad sheyyishgog belav vecharet shebbah.

Verabbi yochanan, hay kera derabbi shimon ben lakish may aved leh? mibbee leh lechidtanya: "meam haaretz" — perat limshummad. rabbi shimon ben elazar omer mishshum rabbi shimon: "asher lo teasena bishgaga veashem". hashshav midiato — mevi korban al shiggato, lo shav midiato — eno mevi korban al shiggato.

Tenan: avot melachot arbaim chaser achat. vehavenan ba: minyana lema li? veamar rabbi yochanan: sheim asaan kullan behelem echad — chayyayv al kol achat veachat. hechi mashkachat la — bizdon shabbat veshiggat melachot.

Bishlama lerabbi yochanan, deamar kevan sheshshagag becharet af al pi shehezid belav — mashkachat la kegon deyada le leshabbat belav. ella lerabbi shimon ben lakish, deamar ad sheyyishgog belav uvecharet — deyada leh leshabbat bemay? deyade bitchumin, veallibba derabbi akiva.

Man tena leha detanu rabbanan: shagag baze uvaze — zehu shogeg haamur battora. hezid baze uvaze — zehu mezid haamur battora. shagag beshabbat vehezid bimlachot, o sheshshagag bimlachot vehezid beshabbat, o sheamar: yodea ani shemmelacha zo asura, aval eni yodea shechayyayvin aleha korban o lo — chayyayv. keman — kemonbaz.

Amar abbaye: hakkol modim bishvuat bittuy, sheen chayyayvin aleha korban ad sheyyishgog belav shebbah. "hakkol modim", man — rabbi yochanan. peshita, ki kaamar rabbi yochanan, hecha deikka karet, aval hacha delekka karet — la!
Salka datach amena, hoil vechayyayv korban — chiddush hu, divchol hattora kullah la ashkechan lav demayyte aleh korban, vehacha mayyte — ki shagag bekorban name lichayyayv,
b: Ka mashma lan. metivi: ezohi shiggat shevuat bittuy lesheavar — sheim amar "yodea ani sheshshevua zo asura, aval eni yodea im chayyayvin aleha korban o lo" — chayyayv! ha manni? — monbaz hi.

(Lishshana acharina: manni? illema monbaz — peshita, hasheta bechol hattora delav chiddush hu amar shiggat korban shemah shegaga, hacha dechiddush hu — lo kol shekken?! ella lav rabbanan hi, uteyuveta deabbaye! teyuveta.)

Veamar abbaye: hakkol modim bitruma sheen chayyayvin aleha chomesh ad sheyyishgog belav shebbah. "hakkol modim" man? — rabbi yochanan. peshita! ki amar rabbi yochanan hecha deikka karet, hecha delekka karet la! mahu detema: mita bimkom karet omedet, vechi shagag bemita name lichayyayv — ka mashma lan. rava amar: mita bimkom karet omedet vechomesh bimkom korban kae.

Amar rav huna: haya mehallech badderech o bammidbar veeno yodea ematay shabbat, mone shishsha yamim umeshammer yom echad. chiyyay bar rav omer: meshammer yom echad, umone shishsha. bemay kamippalgi — mar savar kivriyyayto shel olam, umar savar keadam harishon. metivi: haya mehallech badderech veeno yodea ematay shabbat meshammer yom echad leshishsha. may lav, mone shishsha umeshammer yom echad?! la, meshammer yom echad umone shishsha.

I hachi "meshammer yom echad leshishsha" — "meshammer yom echad umone shishsha" mibbee leh. veod, tanya: haya mehallech badderech o bammidbar veeno yodea ematay shabbat, mone shishsha umeshammer yom echad, teyuveta derabbi chiyyay bar rav! teyuveta.

Amar rava: bechol yom vayom ose lo kede farnasato [bar mehahu yoma]. vehahu yoma lemut?! deaved meetmol shete farnasot. vedilma meetmol shabbat havay! ella kol yom vayom ose lo parnasato, afillu hahu yoma. vehahu yoma bemay minnechar leh? bekiddusha veavdalta.

Amar rava: im haya makkir miktzat hayyom sheyyatza bo, ose melacha kol hayyom kullo. peshita! mahu detema: kevan deshabbat la nafek, bemaale shabbeta [name] la nafek. vehay, i name bechamsha beshabbeta nafek — lishtere leh lemebad melacha tere yome — ka mashma lan zimnin demashkach sheyyayrta umikkere venafek.

Hayyodea ikkar shabbat: menahane mille? amar rav nachman amar rabba bar avu: tere kerae ketivi: "veshamru vene yisrael et hashshabbat", uchetiv: "veet shabbetotay tishmoru". ha ketzad? "veshamru vene yisrael et hashshabbat" — shemira achat leshabbatot harebe. "veet shabbetotay tishmoru" — shemira achat lechol shabbat veshabbat.

Matkif la rav nachman bar yitzchak: adderabba, ippecha mistabbera: "veshamru vene yisrael et hashshabbat" — shemira achat lechol shabbat veshabbat. "veet shabbetotay tishmoru" — shemira achat leshabbatot harebe.
Hayyodea shehu shabbat.

a: May shena resha umay shena sefa? amar rav safra: kan — midiat shabbat hu poresh, vechan — midiat melacha hu poresh. amar leh rav nachman: kelum peresh mishshabbat ella mishshum melachot, uchelum peresh mimmelachot ella mishshum shabbat! ella amar rav nachman: korban dechayyev rachamana ammay — ashshegaga. hatam chada shegaga, hacha tuva shegagot havyayn.

Chayyayv al kol melacha umelacha: chilluk melachot menalan? amar shemuel, amar kera: "mechalleleha mot yumat" — hattora ribbeta mitot harebe al chillul echad. hay bemezid ketiv! im eno inyan lemezid, dichtiv: "kol haose melacha yumat", tenehu inyan leshogeg. umay "yumat"? — yumat bemamon.

Vetippok leh chilluk melachot mehecha denafka leh lerabbi natan! detanya, rabbi natan omer: "lo tevaaru esh bechol moshvotechem beyom hashshabbat" ma talmud lomar? lefi shenneemar "vayyakhel moshe et kol adat bene yisrael elle haddevarim vegomer sheshet yamim tease melacha". "devarim", "haddevarim", "elle haddevarim" — ellu sheloshim vatesha melachot shenneemru lemoshe besinay.

Yachol asaan kullan behelem echad eno chayyayv ella achat? talmud lomar: "becharish uvakkatzir tishbot". vaadayin ani omer: al charisha veal ketzira chayyayv shetayim, veal kullan eno chayyayv ella achat?! talmud lomar: "lo tevaaru esh" — haveara bakkelal hayta, velamma yatzat? — lehakkish eleha velomar lach: ma haveara shehi av melacha vechayyayvin aleha bifne atzmah, af kol shehi av melacha — chayyayvin aleha bifne atzmah.
Shemuel savar la kerabbi yose, deamar: haveara — lelav yatzat. detanya: haveara — lelav yatzat, divre rabbi yose. rabbi natan omer: lechallek yatzat.

Vetippok leh lechilluk melachot mehecha denafka leh lerabbi yose! detanya, rabbi yose omer: "veasa meachat mehenna", peamim shechayyayvim achat al kullan, ufeamim shechayyayvin al kol achat veachat. veamar rabbi yose berabbi chanina: may tama derabbi yose, "achat" "meachat", "henna" "mehenna" — achat shehi henna, henna shehi achat.
"Achat" — shimon. "meachat" —
b: Shem mishshimon. "henna" — avot, "mehenna" — toladot. "achat shehi henna" — zedon shabbat veshiggat melachot. "henna shehi achat" — shiggat shabbat uzedon melachot. ushemuel, "achat shehi henna" vehenna shehi achat" la mashma leh.

Bea minneh rava merav nachman: helem ze vaze beyado, mahu? amar leh: hare helem shabbat beyado, veeno chayyayv ella achat. adderabba, hare helem melachot beyado vechayyayv al kol achat veachat! ella amar rav ashe: chazenan, i mishshum shabbat ka faresh — hare helem shabbat beyado veeno chayyayv ella achat, vei mishshum melacha kafaresh — hare helem melachot beyado vechayyayv al kol achat veachat. amar leh ravina lerav ashe: kelum peresh mishshabbat ella mishshum melachot, kelum peresh mimmelachot ella mishshum shabbat — ella la shena.

Tenan: avot melachot arbaim chaser achat, vehavenan ba: minyana lema li? veamar rabbi yochanan: sheim asaan kullan behelem echad — chayyayv al kol achat veachat. i amrat bishlama helem ze vaze beyado chayyayv al kol achat veachat — shappir, ella i amrat helem shabbat beyado eno chayyayv ella achat, hechi mashkachat la — bizdon shabbat veshiggat melachot!

Hanicha i savar la kerabbi yochanan, deamar kevan sheshshagag becharet af al pi shehezid belav, mashkachat la deyada leh leshabbat belav. ella i savar la kerabbi shimon ben lakish, deamar ad sheyyishgog belav vecharet — deyada leh leshabbat bemay? deyada le bitchumin, veallibba derabbi akiva.

Amar rava: katzar vetachan kigrogeret beshiggat shabbat uzedon melachot, vechazar vekatzar vetachan kigrogeret bizdon shabbat veshiggat melachot, venoda lo al ketzira utechina shel shiggat shabbat uzedon melachot, vechazar venoda lo al ketzira veal techina shel zedon shabbat veshiggat melachot —

a: Ketzira goreret ketzira, utechina goreret techina. aval noda lo al ketzira shel zedon shabbat veshiggat melachot — ketzira goreret ketzira utechina sheimmah, utechina shekkenegdah bimkomah omedet.

Abbaye amar: techina name goreret techina, shem techina achat hi. umi it leh lerava gerira? veha ittemar: achal shene zete chelev behelem echad, venoda lo al achat mehen, vechazar veachal kezayit behelemo shel sheni. amar rava: hevi korban al rishon — rishon vesheni mitkapperin, shelishi eno mitkapper.

Hevi korban al hashshelishi — shelishi vesheni mitkapperin, rishon eno mitkapper. hevi korban al haemtzai — nitkapperu kullan. abbaye amar: afillu hevi korban al echad mehen — nitkapperu kullan. batar deshama meabbaye, savra: i hachi, techina name tigror litchina! gerira it leh, gerira digrira let leh.

Milleta difshita lehu leabbaye verava mibbaya lerabbi zera. devae rabbi zera merabbi assi, veamri la bea minneh rabbi yirmeya merabbi zera: katzar vetachan chatzi gerogeret beshiggat shabbat uzedon melachot, vechazar vekatzar vetachan chatzi gerogeret bizdon shabbat veshiggat melachot, mahu sheyyitztarfu? amar leh: chalukin lachataot, velo mitztarfin.

Vechol hecha dachalukin lachataot la mitztarfi? vehatnan: achal chelev vechelev behelem echad — eno chayyayv ella achat. achal chelev vadam venotar ufiggul behelem echad — chayyayv al kol achat veachat, ze chomer beminin harebe mimmin echad. veze chomer bemin echad mimminin harebe: sheim achal chatzi zayit vechazar veachal chatzi zayit mimmin echad — chayyayv, mishshene minin — patur.

Vehavenan ba: mimmin echad chayyayv tzericha lememar? veamar resh lakish mishshum bar tuteni: hacha bemay askinan — kegon sheachalo bishne tamchuyin, verabbi yehoshua hi, deamar tamchuyin mechallekin. mahu detema amar rabbi yehoshua ben lekulla ben lechumera — ka mashma lan dilkulla la amar, lechumera kaamar.

Veha hacha dachalukin lachataot, veka mitztarfi! amar leh: mar aresha matne la vekashya leh. anan assefa matninan la, vela kashya lan: mishshene minin patur, tzericha lememar? veamar resh lakish mishshum bar tuteni leolam mimmin echad. veammay kare leh "shene minin" — sheachalo bishne tamchuyin, verabbi yehoshua hi deamar tamchuyin mechallekin. veha ka mashma lan: deamar rabbi yehoshua ben lekulla ben lechumera.
Middesefa min echad ushene tamchuyin,
b: Mikkelal deresha min echad vetamchuy echad. min echad vetamchuy echad tzericha lememar?! amar rav huna: hacha bemay askinan — kegon shehayta lo yedia bentayim. verabban gamliel hi deamar: en yedia lachatzi shiur.

Ittemar: achal shene zete chelev behelem echad, venoda lo al harishon, vechazar venoda lo al hashsheni. rabbi yochanan amar: chayyayv shetayim. veresh lakish amar: eno chayyayv ella achat. rabbi yochanan amar chayyayv: "al chattato ... vehevi". veresh lakish amar patur: "mechattato venislach lo".

Veresh lakish, hachtiv: "al chattato ... vehevi"! hahu leachar kappara. ulerabbi yochanan name, hachtiv: "mechattato venislach lo"! hacha bemay askinan — kegon sheachal kezayit umechetza, venoda lo al kezayit, vechazar veachal kachatzi zayit achar behelemo shel sheni. mahu detema litztarfu — ka mashma lan.

Amar leh ravina lerav ashe: deityeda leh kodem haferasha peligi, uveha peligi: demar savar yediot mechallekot, umar savar haferashot mechallekot, aval leachar haferasha mode leh resh lakish lerabbi yochanan dechayyayv shetayim. o dilma deityeda leh leachar haferasha peligi, uveha peligi: demar savar haferashot mechallekot, umar savar kapparot mechallekot. aval kodem haferasha mode leh rabbi yochanan leresh lakish deeno chayyayv ella achat. o dilma ben bazo uven bazo machaloket?

Amar leh: mistabbera ben bazo uven bazo machaloket. dei salka datach kodem haferasha peligi, aval leachar haferasha mode leh resh lakish lerabbi yochanan dechayyayv shetayim — addemokem leh kera leachar kappara, lokmeh leachar haferasha! vei achar haferasha peligi, aval kodem haferasha mode leh rabbi yochanan leresh lakish deeno chayyayv ella achat, addemoke leh kera bichzayit umechetza, lokmeh kodem haferasha!

Vedilma sappoke mesappeka leh, veim timtze lomar" kaamar: im timtze lomar kodem haferasha peligi ba, rabbi yochanan hechi moke leh likra — bichzayit umechetza. veim timtze lomar leachar haferasha peligi, resh lakish hechi moke leh likra — bilachar kappara.
Amar ulla: leman deamar asham vadday, la bae yedia battechilla,

a: Baal chamesh beilot beshifcha charufa — eno chayyayv ella achat. matkif la rav hamenuna: ella meatta baal vechazar uvaal vehifrish korban, veamar: hametinu li ad sheevol, hachi name deeno chayyayv ella achat? amar leh: maase dilachar haferasha kaamrat?! maase dilachar haferasha la kaamena.

Ki ata rav dimi amar: leman deamar asham vadday bae yedia battechilla, baal chamesh beilot beshifcha charufa — chayyayv al kol achat veachat. amar leh abbaye: hare chattat, devaenan yedia battechilla, ufeligi rabbi yochanan verabbi shimon ben lakish! ishtik. amar leh: dilma bemaase dilachar haferasha kaamrat, vechidrav hamenuna? amar leh: in.

Ki ata ravin, amar: hakkol modim beshifcha charufa, vehakkol modim beshifcha charufa, umachloket beshifcha charufa. hakkol modim beshifcha charufa deeno chayyayv ella achat — kidulla. vehakkol modim beshifcha charufa dechayyayv al kol achat veachat — kerav hamenuna. umachloket beshifcha charufa — leman deamar asham vadday bae yedia battechilla, machaloket derabbi yochanan verabbi shimon ben lakish.
Ittemar:
b: Nitkavven lehagebiah et hattalush, vechatach et hamechubbar — patur. lachtoch et hattalush, vechatach et hamechubbar, rava amar: patur. abbaye amar: chayyayv. rava amar patur — deha la mikkavvevn lachaticha deissura. abbaye amar chayyayv — deha kamikkavven lachaticha bealma.

Amar rava: mena amena la? detanya: chomer shabbat mishshear mitzvot, vechomer shear mitzvot mishshabbat. chomer shabbat mishshear mitzvot, shehashshabbat asa shetayim behelem echad — chayyayv al kol achat veachat, ma sheen ken bishar mitzvot. vechomer shear mitzvot mishshabbat — shebbishar mitzvot shagag belo mitkavven — chayyayv, ma sheen ken beshabbat.

Amar mar: chomer shabbat mishshear mitzvot, shehashshabbat asa shetayim behelem echad — chayyayv al kol achat veachat, ma sheen ken bishar mitzvot. hechi dame? illema daavad ketzira utechina, dichvota gabbe shear mitzvot achal chelev vedam. hacha tarte michayyayv, vehacha tarte michayyayv! ella shear mitzvot dela michayyayv ella chada hechi dame — daachal chelev vechelev. dichvota gabbe shabbat — daavad ketzira uketzira, hacha chada michayyayv, vehacha chada michayyayv!
Leolam daavad ketzira utechina, umay "ma sheen ken bishar mitzvot" — aavoda zara, vechidrabbi amme. deamar rabbi amme: zibbach vekitter venissech behaalama achat — eno chayyayv ella achat.

Bemay okemta — baavoda zara? ema sefa: chomer bishar mitzvot, shebbishar mitzvot shagag belo mitkavven — chayyayv, ma sheen ken beshabbat — hay shagag belo mitkavven daavoda zara hechi dame? illema kesavur bet hakkeneset hu vehishtachava lah — hare libbo lashshamayim. veella dechaze inderata vesaged le, hechi dame? i dekabbele aleh beeloah — mezid hu. vei dela kabbele aleh beeloah — lav kelum hu.
Ella meahava umiyyira. hanicha leabbaye, deamar chayyayv. ella lerava deamar patur, may ikka lememar? ella beomer "muttar". ma sheen ken beshabbat defatur — ligmare.
Ad kan la bea minneh rava merav nachman, ella i lechayyove chada, i lechayyove tarte, aval miftereh ligmare — la.

a: Ella lav, resha baavoda zara vesefa bishar mitzvot. veshagag belo mitkavven bishar mitzvot hechi dame? — desavur deshumman hu, vaachalo. ma sheen ken beshabbat defatur, denitkavvevn lachtoch et hattalush vechatach et hamechubbar patur. veabbaye shagag belo mitkavven hechi dame? — desavur rok hu, uvelao. ma sheen ken beshabbat, defatur, denitkavvevn lehagebiah et hattalush vechatach et hamechubbar patur. aval nitkavvevn lachtoch et hattalush vechatach et hamechubbar — chayyayv.

Ittemar: nitkavvevn lizrok shetayim vezarak arba, rava amar: patur. abbaye amar: chayyayv. rava amar patur — dela kamikkavven lizrika dearba. abbaye amar chayyayv — deha kamikkavven lizrika bealma. kesavur reshut hayyachid, venimtzet reshut harabbim — rava amar: patur, veabbaye amar: chayyayv. rava amar patur — deha la mikkaven lizrika deissura. veabbaye amar chayyayv — deha ka mikkaven lizrika bealma.

Utzericha: dei ashmeinan kammayyta, behahi kaamar rava — deha la kamikkavven lachaticha deissura. aval nitkavvevn lizrok shetayim vezarak arba, dearba bela tarte la mizdarki leh, ema mode leh leabbaye. vei ashmeinan beha, beha kaamar rava — deha la kamikkavven lizrika dearba, aval kesavur reshut hayyachid venimtza reshut harabbim, demikkavven lizrika dearba — ema mode leh leabbaye, tzericha.

Tenan "avot melachot arbaim chaser achat", vehavenan ba: minyana lema li? veamar rabbi yochanan: sheim asaan kullam behelem echad — chayyayv al kol achat veachat, bishlama leabbaye deamar ki hay gavvna chayyayv, mashkachat la deyada issura deshabbat veyada (la) issur melachot, veka tae beshiurin. ella lerava deamar patur, hechi mashkachat la bizdon shabbat veshiggat melachot?

Hanicha i savar la kerabbi yochanan, deamar kevan sheshshagag becharet, af al pi shehezid belav — mashkachat la deyada la leshabbat belav. ella i savar la kerabbi shimon ben lakish, deamar ad sheyyishgog belav vecharet, deyada la leshabbat bemay? deyada la bitchumin, veallibba derabbi akiva.
Mishna avot melachot arbaim chaser achat: hazzorea, vehachoresh, vehakkotzer, vehameammer, vehaddash, vehazzore. habborer, hattochen, vehamerakked, vehallash, vehaofe.

Haggozez et hatztzemer, hamelabbeno, vehamenappetzo, vehatztzovo, vehattove, vehammesech, vehaose shete vatte nirin, vehaoreg shene chutin, vehappotzea shene chutin. hakkosher, vehammattir, vehattofer shete tefirot, hakkorea al menat litpor [shete tefirot].
Hatztzad tzevi, hashshochato, vehammafshito, hammolcho, vehameabbed et oro, vehamemachako, vehamechattecho.

Hakkotev shete otiyyot, vehammochek al menat lichtov shete otiyyot. habbone, vehassoter, hamechabbe, vehammavir, hammakke befattish, hammotzi mershut lirshut — hare ellu avot melachot arbaim chaser achat.
b: Gemara minyana lema li? amar rabbi yochanan: sheim asaan kullam behelem echad — chayyayv al kol achat veachat.
Hazzorea vehachoresh. mikkede michrav karvi beresha, litne choresh vahadar litne zorea! tanna beeretz yisrael kae dezari beresha vahadar karvi.

Tana: hazzorea, vehazzomer, vehannotea, vehammavrich, vehammarkiv — kullan melacha achat hen. may ka mashma lan? [ha ka mashma lan] haose melachot harebe meen melacha achat eno chayyayv ella achat. amar rabbi acha, amar rabbi chiyyay bar ashe, amar rabbi amme: zomer chayyayv mishshum notea, vehannotea vehammavrich vehammarkiv chayyayv mishshum zorea. mishshum zorea in, mishshum notea la? ema: af mishshum zorea.

Amar rav kahana: zomer vetzarich laetzim — chayyayv shetayim: achat mishshum kotzer, veachat mishshum notea. amar rav yosef: hay man dekatel aspasta chayyayv shetayim: achat mishshum kotzer, veachat mishshum notea. amar abbaye: hay man dekanev silka chayyayv shetayim: achat mishshum kotzer, veachat mishshum zorea.

Vehachoresh. tana: hachoresh vehachofer vehachoretz kullan melacha achat hen. amar rav sheshet: hayta lo gavshushit unetalah, babbayit — chayyayv mishshum bone, bassade — chayyayv mishshum choresh. amar rava: hayta lo gumma utemamah, babbayit — chayyayv mishshum bone, bassade — mishshum choresh.

Amar rabbi abba: hachofer gumma beshabbat veeno tzarich ella laafarah — patur aleha. vaafillu lerabbi yehuda, deamar melacha sheenah tzericha legufah chayyayv aleha — hane mille metakken, hay — mekalkel hu.

Vehakkotzer. tana: hakkotzer, habbotzer, vehaggoder vehammassik, vehaore — kullan melacha achat. amar rav pappa: hay man dishda pissa ledikla veattar tamre chayyayv shetayim: achat mishshum tolesh, veachat mishshum mefarek. rav ashe amar: en derech telisha bechach, veen derech perika bechach.
Vehameammer. amar rava: hay man dechanef milcha mimmilchata chayyayv mishshum meammer. abbaye amar: en immur ella begiddule karka.
Vehaddash. tana: haddash, vehamenappetz, vehamenappet — kullan melacha achat hen.
Hazzore, habborer, vehattochen, vehamerakked. hayeynu zore, hayeynu borer, hayeynu merakked. abbaye verava deamri tarvayyhu: kol milleta dahavay bemishkan,

a: Af al gav deikka dedamya la — chashev la. velichshov name kotesh! amar abbaye: shekken ani ochel pitto belo ketisha. rava amar: ha manni — rabbi hi, deamar avot melachot arbaim chaser achat, vei chashev kotesh havya leh arbaim. velaypek chada mehanach uleayyel kotesh! ella mechavvavrta kidabbaye.

Tanu rabbanan: hayu lefanav mine ochalin — borer veochel, borer umanniach. velo yivror, veim berar — chayyayv chattat. may kaamar? amar ulla, hachi kaamar: borer veochel levo bayyom, uvorer umanniach levo bayyom. ulemachar lo yivror, veim berar — chayyayv chattat. matkif la rav chisda: vechi muttar leefot levo bayyom? vechi muttar levashshel levo bayyom?

Ella amar rav chisda: borer veochel pachot mikkeshiur, borer umanniach pachot mikkeshiur. ucheshiur lo yivror, veim berar — chayyayv chattat. matkif la rav yosef: vechi muttar leefot pachot mikkeshiur? ella amar rav yosef: borer veochel bayyad, borer umanniach bayyad. bekanon uvetamchuy lo yivror, veim berar — patur aval asur, uvenafa uvichvara lo yivror, veim berar — chayyayv chattat.

Matkif la rav hamenuna: midde kanon vetamchuy katane? ella amar rav hamenuna: borer veochel ochel mittoch happesolet, borer umanniach ochel mittoch happesolet. pesolet mittoch ochel lo yivror, veim berar — chayyayv chattat. matkif la abbaye: midde ochel mittoch pesolet katane? ella amar abbaye: borer veochel lealtar, uvorer umanniach lealtar, ulevo bayyom — lo yivror, veim berar — naasa kevorer laotzar vechayyayv chattat. amruha rabbanan kammeh derava, amar lehu: shappir amar nachmani.

Hayu lefanav shene mine ochalin, uverar veachal, uverar vehinniach. rav ashe matne: patur, rabbi yirmeya middifti matne: chayyayv. rav ashe matne patur, veha tane chayyayv! la kashya: ha bekanon vetamchuy, ha benafa uchevara.

Ki ata rav dimi, amar: shabbeta derav bivi havay, veikkelau rabbi amme verabbi assi, sheda kammayyhu kalkalla defere. vela yadana i mishshum desavar ochel mittoch pesolet asur, i mishshum ayin yafa hu demikkavven.
Chizkiyya amar: habborer turemosim mittoch pesolet shellahen — chayyayv. lema kasavar chizkiyya ochel mittoch pesolet asur? shane turemosa
b: Deshalki leh shiva zimne, vei la shakli leh masrach — vechifsolet mittoch ochel dame.

Vehattochen. amar rav pappa: hay man defarem silka — chayyayv mishshum tochen. amar rav menashshe: hay man desalet silte — chayyayv mishshum tochen. amar rav ashe: i kafed ammishchata — chayyayv mishshum mechattech.
Vehallash vehaofe. amar rav pappa: shevak tanna didan bishshul sammanin dahava bemishkan unekat ofe?! tanna didan siddura defat naket.

Amar rav acha bar rav avvira: hay man dishda sikketa leattuna — chayyayv mishshum mevashshel. peshita! mahu detema lesharore mana ka mikkaven, ka mashma lan demirpa rafe vahadar kamet. amar rabba bar rav huna: hay man deartach kufera — chayyayv mishshum mevashshel. peshita! mahu detema kevan dahadar veikkish ema la, ka mashma lan.

Amar rava: hay man daavad chavita — chayyayv mishshum sheva chattaot. tannura — chayyayv mishshum shemone chattaot. amar abbaye: hay man daavad challeta — chayyayv achat esre chattaot. vei chayyeyteh lefummeh — chayyayv shelosh esre chattaot.

Haggozez et hatztzemer vehamelabbeno. amar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan: hattove tzemer sheal gabbe behema beshabbat — chayyayv shalosh chattaot: achat mishshum gozez, veachat mishshum menappetz, veachat mishshum tove. rav kahana amar: en derech geziza bechach, veen derech menappetz bechach, veen derech tevivyya bechach. vela? vehatanya mishshemeh derabbi nechemya: shatuf baizzim, vetavuy baizzim, alma tevivyya al gabbe behema shemah tevivyya! chachma yetera shane.

Tanu rabbanan: hattolesh et hakkanaf vehakkotmo vehammorto — chayyayv shalosh chattaot. veamar rabbi shimon ben lakish: tolesh — chayyayv mishshum gozez, kotem — chayyayv mishshum mechattech, memaret — chayyayv mishshum memachek.

Hakkosher vehammattir. keshira bammishkan hecha havay? amar rava: shekken koshrin beyitdot ohalim. koshrim?! hahu kosher al menat lehattir hu. ella amar abbaye: shekken orge yeriot shennifseka lahen nima koshrim otah. amar leh rava: taretzt kosher, mattir may ikka lememar? vechi tema: dei mitreme leh tere (chute) kitre bahade hadade, share chad vekatar chad — hasheta lifne melech basar vadam en osin ken, lifne melech malche hammelachim hakkadosh baruch hu, osin?! ella amar rava veittema rabbi illay, shekken tzade chillazon koshrin umattirin.
Vehattofer shete tefirot. veha la kayyma! amar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan: vehu shekkesharan.
Hakkorea al menat litpor. keria bammishkan mi hava? rabba verabbi zera deamri tarvavyyhu:

a: Shekken yeria shennafal bah darna, korin bah vetofrin otah.

Amar rav zutera bar toviyya amar rav: hammoteach chut shel tefira beshabbat — chayyayv chattat, vehallomed davar echad min hammagosh — chayyayv mita, vehayyodea lechashshev tekufot umazzalot veeno mechashshev — asur lesapper hemennu.

Amgusheta — rav ushemuel, chad amar: charashe, vechad amar: gadofe. tistayyem derav deamar gadofe, deamar rav zutera bar toviyya amar rav: hallomed davar echad min hammagosh chayyayv mita. dei salka datach charashe: hachtiv "lo tilmad laasot" — aval atta lamed lehavin ulehorot — tistayyem.

Amar rabbi shimon ben pazzi, amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi mishshum bar kappara: kol hayyodea lechashshev bitkufot umazzalot veeno mechashshev, alav hakkatuv omer: "veet poal Adonai lo yabbitu umaase yadav lo rau". amar rabbi shemuel bar nachmani amar rabbi yochanan: minnayin shemmitzva al haadam lechashshev tekufot umazzalot — shenneemar: "ushemartem vaasitem ki hi chochmatchem uvinatchem leene haammim", ezo chachma uvina shehi leene haammim — heve omer: ze chishshuv tekufot umazzalot.

Hatztzad tzevi vechulei. tanu rabbanan: hatztzad chillazon vehappotzo — eno chayyayv ella achat. rabbi yehuda omer chayyayv shetayim. shehaya rabbi yehuda omer: petzia bichlal disha. amru lo: en petzia bichlal disha. amar rava: may tama derabbanan — kasavri en disha ella legiddule karka. velichayyayv name mishshum netilat neshama! amar rabbi yochanan: sheppetzao met.
