Rava amar: afillu tema sheppetzao chay, mitassek hu etzel netilat neshama. veha abbaye verava deamri tarvavyyhu: mode rabbi shimon bifsik resheh velo yamut"! shane hacha, dechamma deit beh neshama tefe nicha leh, ki hechi deletzil tziveh.
Vehashshochato. shochet mishshum may chayyayv? rav amar: mishshum tzovea. ushemuel amar: mishshum netilat neshama.
b: Mishshum tzovea in, mishshum netilat neshama la? ema: af mishshum tzovea. amar rav: milleta daamari, ema ba milleta, dela letu dare batrae velichachu alay: tzovea bemay nicha leh — nicha delittavvavs bet hashshechita dema, ki hechi delichzu inashe veletu lizbenu minneh.

Vehammolcho vehameabbedo. hayeynu moleach vehayeynu meabbed! rabbi yochanan veresh lakish deamri tarvayyhu: appek chad minnayyhu veayyel sirtut. amar rabba bar rav huna: hay man demalach bisra — chayyayv mishshum meabbed. rava amar: en ibbud baochalin. amar rav ashe: vaafillu rabba bar rav huna la amar ella deka bae leh leorcha, aval leveta — la meshavve inish mechleh etz.

Vehamemachako vehamechattecho. amar rabbi acha bar chanina: hashshaf ben haammudim beshabbat — chayyayv mishshum memachek. amar rabbi chiyyay bar abba: shelosha devarim sach li rav ashe mishshemeh derabbi yehoshua ben levi: hamegarer rashe kelonsot beshabbat — chayyayv mishshum mechattech, hamemareach retiyya beshabbat — chayyayv mishshum memachek, vehamesattet et haeven beshabbat — chayyayv mishshum makke befattish. amar rabbi shimon ben kisma amar rabbi shimon ben lakish: hatztzar tzura bichli vehamenappeach bichli zechuchit — chayyayv mishshum makke befattish. amar rav yehuda: hay man deshakel akkufe miggelime — chayyayv mishshum makke befattish. vehane mille dekafed alayyhu.

Vehakkotev shete otiyyot. tanu rabbanan: katav ot achat gedola veyesh bimkomah lichtov shetayim — patur. machak ot gedola, veyesh bimkomah lichtov shetayim — chayyayv. amar rabbi menachem berabbi yose: ze chomer bammochek mibbakkotev.
Habbone, vehassoter, hamechabbe, vehammavir, vehammakke befattish. rabba verabbi zera deamri tarvayyhu: kol midde deit beh gemar melacha chayyayv mishshum makke befattish.

"Ellu avot melachot". "ellu" — leappoke midderabbi eliezer, dimchayyev al tolada bimkom av. "chaser achat" — leappoke midderabbi yehuda, detanya: rabbi yehuda mosif et hashshovet vehamedakdek. amru lo: shovet hare hu bichlal mesech, medakdek hare hu bichlal oreg.

Mishna veod kelal acher amru: kol hakkasher lehatzenia umatzniin kamohu vehotzio beshabbat — chayyayv chattat alav. vechol sheeno kasher lehatzenia veen matzniin kamohu vehotzio beshabbat — eno chayyayv ella hammatznio.

Gemara "kol hakkasher lehatzenia" leappoke may? rav pappa amar: leappoke dam nidda. mar uvkva amar: leappoke atze ashera. man deamar dam nidda, kol shekken atze ashera. man deamar atze ashera, aval dam nidda matzna leh leshunnara. veiddach? — kevan dechalsha la matzna leh.
Amar rabbi yose bar chanina hay dela kerabbi shimon, dei kerabbi shimon, haamar: lo amru kol hashshiurin hallalu ella lematzniehen.
Vechol sheeno kasher lehatzenia.

a: Amar rabbi elazar: ha dela kerabbi shimon ben elazar. detanya, kelal amar rabbi shimon ben elazar: kol sheeno kasher lehatzenia, veen matzniin kamohu, vehucheshar laze vehitznio, uva acher vehotzio — nitchayyev ze bemachshava shel ze.

Mishna hammotzi teven — kimlo fi fara. atza — kimlo fi gamal. amir — kimlo fi tale. asavim — kimlo fi gedi. ale shum vaale vetzalim, lachim — kigrogeret, yeveshim — kimlo fi gedi. veen mitztarfin ze im ze mippene shello shavu beshiurehen.

Gemara may atza? amar rav yehuda: teven shel mine kitnit. ki ata rav dimi, amar: hammotzi teven kimlo fi fara legamal, rabbi yochanan amar: chayyayv, rabbi shimon ben lakish amar: patur. beureta amar rabbi yochanan hachi, letzafra hadar beh. amar rav yosef: shappir avad dahadar, deha la chaze legamal! amar leh abbaye: adderabba, kidmeikkara mistabbera, deha chaze lefara.
Ella ki ata ravin, amar: hammotzi teven kimlo fi fara legamal, dechulle alma la peligi dechayyayv. ki peligi, bemotzi atza kimlo fi fara lefara.

Veippecha ittemar: rabbi yochanan amar patur, resh lakish amar chayyayv. rabbi yochanan amar patur — achila al yede haddechak lo shemah achila. resh lakish amar chayyayv — achila al yede haddechak shemah achila.
Amir kimlo fi tale. vehatanya kigrogeret! idde veidde chad shiura hu.

Ale shum vaale vetzalim, lachim kigrogeret, viveshim kimlo fi haggedi, veen mitztarfin ze im ze mippene shello shavu beshiurehen. amar rabbi yose bar chanina: en mitztarfin lechamur shebbahen. aval mitztarfin lakkal shebbahen.

Vechol dela shavu beshiurayyhu mi mitztarfin? vehatnan: habbeged — shelosha al shelosha, vehassak — arbaa al arbaa, vehaor — chamishsha al chamishsha, mappatz — shishsha al shishsha. vetane ala: habbeged vehassak, hassak vehaor, haor vehammappatz — mitztarfin ze im ze. veamar rabbi shimon: ma taam — mippene sheruyin litamme moshav. tama diruyin litamme moshav, aval en rauy litamme moshav — la!
Amar rava:
b: Hacha name, chazya ledugema.

Mishna hammotzi ochalim kigrogeret — chayyayv, umitztarfin ze im ze mippene sheshshavu beshiurehen. chutz mikkelippatan, vegarinehen, veuketzehen, vesubban, umuresanan. rabbi yehuda omer: chutz mikkelippe adashin shemmitbashshelot immahen.
Gemara vesubban umuresanan lo mitztarfin? vehatnan: chameshet revaim kemach veod, chayyayvin bachalla hen vesubban umuresanan! amar abbaye: shekken ani ochel pitto beissa belusa.

Rabbi yehuda omer: chutz mikkelippe adashim hammitbashshelot immahen. adashim in, polin la? vehatanya, rabbi yehuda omer: chutz mikkelippe polin vaadashim! la kashya: ha bechadte, ha beattike. attike may tama la? amar rabbi avahu: mippene shennirin kizvuvin bakkeara.
Haderan alach kelal gadol

Mishna hammotzi yayin — kede mezigat hakkos. chalav — kede gemia. devash — kede litten al hakkatit. shemen — kede lasuch ever katan. mayim — kede lashuf bahem et hakkilor. ushear kol hammashkin birviit, vechol hashshofchin birviit. rabbi shimon omer: kullan birviit, velo neemru kol hashshiurin hallalu ella lematzniehen.
Gemara tana: kede mezigat kos yafe. umay kos yafe — kos shel beracha. amar rav nachman amar rabba bar avu: kos shel beracha tzarich sheyyehe bo rova reviit, kede sheyyimzegennu veyaamod al reviit.
Amar rava: af anan name

a: Tenena: hammotzi yayin — kede mezigat kos, vetane ala: kede mezigat kos yafe. vekatane sefa: "ushear kol hammashkin birviit". verava letameh, deamar rava: kol chamra dela dare al chad telat mayya lav chamra hu.
Amar abbaye: shete teshuvot baddavar — chada, ditnan: vehammazug shene chelke mayim veechad yayin, min hayyayin hashsheroni. veod: mayim bakkad umitztarfin?!

Amar leh rava: ha dekaamrat shene chelke mayim veechad yayin min hayyayin hashsheroni — yayin hashsheroni lechud, derafe. i name, hatam mishshum chazuta, aval letama bae tefe. udekaamrat: mayim bakkad umitztarfin — leinyan shabbat midde dachashiv baenan, veha name — ha chashiv.

Tana: yavesh bichzayit, divre rabbi natan. amar rav yosef: rabbi natan verabbi yose berabbi yehuda amru davar echad. rabbi natan — ha daamaran, verabbi yose berabbi yehuda, detanya: rabbi yehuda omer: shishsha devarim mikkulle bet shammay umechumere bet hillel. dam nevela — bet shammay metaharin, uvet hillel metammein. amar rabbi yose berabbi yehuda: af keshettimmeu bet hillel, lo timmeu ella bedam sheyyesh bo reviit, hoil veyachol likrosh velaamod al kezayit.

Amar abbaye: dilma la hi. ad kan la kaamar rabbi natan hacha dichzayit bae reviit — ella beyayin diklish, aval bedam dismich — kezayit la bae reviit. i name, ad kan la kaamar rabbi yose berabbi yehuda hatam dichzayit saggi leh birviit — ella bedam dismich, aval yayin diklish — kezayit have yoter merviit, vechi mappek pachot mikkezayit lichayyayv.
Chalav kede gemia. ibbaya lehu: "kede gemia", o "kede gemia". amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: "hagemiini na meat mayim mikkaddech".
Ibbaya lehu:
b: "Garinin", o "garinin"? amar rava bar ulla: "venigra meerkecha".
Ibbaya lehu: "ommot", o "ommot"? amar rav yitzchak bar avdimi: "arazim lo amamuhu began elohim".
Ibbaya lehu: "meammetzin" tenan, o "meammetzin". amar rabbi chiyyay bar abba amar rabbi yochanan: "veotzem enav merot bera".

Tanu rabbanan: hammotzi chalav shel behema kede gemia. chalav shel ishsha veloven shel betza — kede litten bimshifa shel kilor. [kilor] kede lashuf bemayim. bae rav ashe: kede shifa, o kede achiza veshifa? teku.
Devash kede litten al hakkatit. tana: kede litten al pi chatit. bae rav ashe: "al katit" — appumma dechulla katit, o dilma ammuresha kamma dechatit, leappoke huderana dela — teku.

Amar rav yehuda amar rav: kol ma shebbara hakkadosh baruch hu beolamo lo bara davar echad levattala. bara shabbelul — lechatit. bara zevuv — letzira. yattush — lenachash. venachash — lachafafit. usemamit — leakrav. hechi aved leh — mayyte chada ukkama vachada chivvara, veshalki lehu veshayyfi leh.

Tanu rabbanan, chamishsha emot hen emat challash al gibbor: emat mafgia al haari, emat yattush al happil, emat semamit al haakrav, emat senunit al hannesher, emat kilbit al livyatan. amar rav yehuda amar rav: may kera — "hammavlig shod al az".

Rabbi zera ashkach lerav yehuda dahava kae appitcha deve chamu, vechazyeh dahava bedicha dateh, vei bae minneh kol chalale alma hava amar leh. amar leh: may tama izze mesaggan beresha vahadar immere? amar leh kivriyyayto shel olam, divresha chashocha vahadar nehora. may tama hane mechasseyayn vehane megalleyayn? hane demikkassinan minnayyhu — mechasseyayn, vehane dela mikkassinan minnayyhu — megalleyayn. may tama gamla zutar genuveteh? mishshum deachel kise. may tama tora aricha genuveteh? mishshum dedayer beagme, uvae lecharkoshe bake.

May tama karna dekamtza rakkicha? mishshum dedayyra bechilfe, vei kashya — nadya umitavvevra. deamar shemuel: hay man devae delisammeye lekamtza — lishlefinhu lekarneh. may tama hay timra detarnegolta middele leella? dedayyri addappe, vei ayel kutra — mitavvevra. "dashsha" — derech sham. "darga" — derech gag. "matkulita" — matay tichle da. "beta" — bo veittev (ba). "bikta" — be akta.

"Kufeta" — kuf vetiv. "livne" — livne bene. "hutza" — chatzitza. "chatzba" — shechotzev mayim min hannahar. "kuza" — kaze. "shutita" — shetuta. "meshichla" — mashe kolla. "meshichleta" — mashya kalleta. "asita" — chassirta. "buchena" — bo veakkenna.

"Levusha" — lo busha. "gelima" — shennaasa bo kegolem. "gulleta" — galli veittev. "pureya" — shepparin veravin aleha. "bor zinka" — bor ze naki. "sudara" — sod Adonai lireav. "appadna" — appitcha den. tanu rabbanan: shelosha kol zeman shemmazkinin mosifin gevura, veellu hen: dag, venachash, vachazir.

Shemen kede lasuch ever katan. amri deve rabbi yannay shemen kede lasuch ever katan shel katan ben yomo. metivi: shemen kede lasuch ever katan, vekatan ben yomo. may lav: ever katan degadol, veever gadol shel katan ben yomo! amri lach deve rabbi yannay — la, hachi kaamar: shemen kede lasuch ever katan, shel katan ben yomo.

Lema ketannae? shemen kede lasuch ever katan, vekatan ben yomo — divre rabbi shimon ben elazar. rabbi natan omer: kede lasuch ever katan. may lav beha kamippalgi: derabbi shimon ben elazar savar ever katan shel katan, verabbi natan savar ever katan degadol, o ever gadol dekatan. aval ever katan shel katan ben yomo — la. la, dechulle alma ever katan dekatan ben yomo la,

a: Veleta derabbi yannay. vehacha beha kamippalgi: rabbi shimon ben elazar savar: ever katan degadol veever gadol dekatan ben yomo ki hadade ninhu, verabbi natan savar: ever katan degadol in, ever gadol dekatan ben yomo — la. may have ala? ta shema: detanya, rabbi shimon ben elazar omer: shemen kede lasuch ever katan shel katan ben yomo.
Mayim kede lashuf bahen et hakkilor. amar abbaye: mikkede kol milleta dishchicha vela shechicha, azul rabbanan batar dishchicha lekulla. shechicha ushechicha azul rabbanan batar dishchicha lechumera.

Yayin, shetiyyayto shechicha refuato la shechicha — azul rabbanan batar shetiyyayto dishchicha lekulla. chalav, achilato shechicha refuato la shechicha — azul rabbanan batar achilato lekulla. devash, achilato shechicha refuato shechicha — azul rabbanan batar refuato lechumera.

Ella mayim, mikkede shetiyyayto shechicha refuato la shechicha, may tama azul rabbanan batar refuato lechumera? amar abbaye: begalila shanu. rava amar: afillu tema bishar mekomot, kedishmuel, deamar shemuel: kol shakyayne massu umetalleli levar mimmayya demassu vela metalleli.

Ushear kol hammashkin birviit. tanu rabbanan: dam vechol mine mashkin birviit. rabbi shimon ben elazar omer: dam, kede lichchol beayin achat, shekken kochalin levarkit. umay ninhu? dema detarnugela bara. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: dam kede lichchol bo ayin achat, shekken kochalin leyarud. umay nihu? dema dichrushetina. vesimanaych: gavva legavva, bara levara.

Bamme devarim amurim — bemotzi, aval bematznia — kol shehu chayyayv. rabbi shimon omer: bamme devarim amurim — bematznia, aval bemotzi — eno chayyayv ella birviit. umodim chachamim lerabbi shimon bemotzi shofchin lirshut harabbim sheshshiuran birviit.

Amar mar: bamme devarim amurim — bemotzi, aval bematznia — kol shehu. attu matznia lav motzi hu? amar abbaye: hacha bemay askinan — betalmid sheamar lo rabbo: lech ufanne li hammakom lisuda. halach ufinna lo. davar chashuv lakkol — chayyayv illaveh, davar sheeno chashuv lakkol, i atzneeh rabbeh — michayyayv illaveh, vei la — la michayyayv.

Amar mar: modim chachamim lerabbi shimon bemotzi shofchin lirshut harabbim sheshshiuran birviit. shofchin lemay chazu? amar rabbi yirmeya: legabbel bahen et hattit. vehatanya: tit kede laasot bahen pi chur! la kashya: ha demiggabbal, ha dela miggabbal — lefi sheen adam toreach legabbel tit laasot pi chur.

Mishna hammotzi chevel — kede laasot ozen lakkuppa. gemi — kede laasot telay lannafa velakkevara. rabbi yehuda omer: kede littol mimmennu middat minal lakkatan. neyayr — kede lichtov alav kesher mochsin. vehammotzi kesher mochsin — chayyayv.
b: Neyayr machuk — kede lichroch al tzelochit ketanna shel pilyayton. or — kede laasot kamea. duchesusetos — kede lichtov mezuza. kelaf — kede lichtov alav parasha ketanna shebbattefillin, shehi "shema yisrael". deyo — kede lichtov shete otiyyot.

Kechol — kede lichchol ayin achat. devek — kede litten berosh hashshafshaf. zefet vegofrit — kede laasot nekev. shaava — kede litten al pi nekev katan. charsit — kede laasot pi chur shel tzorfe zahav. rabbi yehuda omer: kede laasot pitput. subbin — kede litten al pi chur shel tzorfe zahav. sid — kede lasud ketanna shebbabbanot. rabbi yehuda omer: kede laasot kilkul. rabbi nechemya omer: kede lasud unedife.

Gemara chevel name lichayyev kede laasot telay lannafa velakkevara! kevan decharek bemana la avdi inashe. tanu rabbanan: hutzin kede laasot ozen lesal kefifa mitzrit. siv — acherim omrim: kede litten al pi mashpech katan lesannen et hayyayin. revav — kede lasuch tachat espogit ketanna. vechamma shiurah? — kesela. vehatanya kigrogeret! idde veidde chad shiura hu. mochin kede laasot kaddur ketanna, vechamma shiuro? — keegoz.

Neyayr — kede lichtov alav kesher mochsin. tana: kamma kesher mochsin? shete otiyyot shel kesher mochsin. ureminhu: hammotzi neyayr chalak, im yesh bo kede lichtov shete otiyyot — chayyayv, veim lav — patur. amar rav sheshet: may shete otiyyot? shete otiyyot shel kesher mochsin. rava amar: shete otiyyot didan uvet achiza, dehayynu kesher mochsin.

Metivi: hammotzi neyayr machuk ushetar parua, im yesh balloven shello kede lichtov shete otiyyot, o bechullo kede lichroch al pi tzelochit ketanna shel pilyayton — chayyayv, veim lav — patur. bishlama lerav sheshet deamar may "shete otiyyot", shete otiyyot shel kesher mochsin — shappir. ella lerava deamar shete otiyyot didan uvet achiza, dehayynu kesher mochsin — hacha bet achiza la tzerich! kashya.

Tanu rabbanan: hammotzi kesher mochsin, ad shello herahu lammoches — chayyayv. mishsheherahu lammoches — patur. rabbi yehuda omer: af mishsheherahu lammoches chayyayv mippene shetztzarich lo. may benayyhu? amar abbaye: ikka benayyhu rahite mochsa. rava amar: moches gadol umoches katan ikka benayyhu. rav ashe amar: chad moches ikka benayyhu, mippene shetztzarich lo lehareot lemoches sheni, deamar leh: chazi, gavra demoches ana.

Tanu rabbanan: hammotzi shetar chov, ad shello perao — chayyayv, mishshepperao — patur. rabbi yehuda omer: af mishshepperao — chayyayv, mippene shetztzarich lo. may benayyhu? amar rav yosef: asur leshahot shetar parua ikka benayyhu. rabbanan savri: asur leshahot shetar parua. verabbi yehuda savar: muttar leshahot shetar parua.

Abbaye amar: dechulle alma asur leshahot shetar parua, vehacha bemode bishtar shekketavo shetztzarich lekayyeymo kamippalgi: tanna kamma savar mode bishtar shekketavo — tzarich lekayyeymo. verabbi yehuda savar mode bishtar shekketavo — en tzarich lekayyeymo. umay "ad shello perao" umishshepperao"?
